jobs.title: Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics)
jobs.description:
Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics)
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field.

You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output.



 


Responsibilities

  • First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units.

  • Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors.

  • Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches.

  • Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier.

  • Find the real cause. You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures.

  • Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers.

  • See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed.

  • Keep failure, test and repair records traceable.

  • Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects.


    • Requirements

  • You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product.

  • You understand at system level how mechanics, electronics, sensors and firmware work together.

  • You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them.

  • You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack.

  • You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure.

  • You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor.


    • Plus

  • Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics

  • Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR

  • Experience designing electronics PCBAs

  • Experience in software programming

  • SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt

  • Python, SQL, BI or AI tools for data analysis

  • Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software

  • Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD

  • Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams

  • Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA

  • Speaking or understanding German

    • Joining Wingtra, you gain deep insight into applied robotics and aerial photogrammetry. You work in a startup, so you make a personal impact on both the technology and the organization itself.
     
    Please send your CV in English.

    If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

HR Generalist / HR Administration (Part-Time, 20–25h/week) Middelharnis, Netherlands | Thermoheat B.V.

Join Thermoheat B.V. and help shape the future of HR in an international industrial environment.

We are looking for a HR Generalist (m/f/d) to support and develop our HR processes across the Thermoheat Group. This is a part-time position (20–25 hours/week).

Company Overview

Thermoheat B.V. is an established company with over 40 years of experience in the refractory industry and part of the internationally active LOEWE Group, a family-owned business founded in 1962.

With locations in the Netherlands and Portugal, Thermoheat delivers tailor-made refractory solutions for industrial clients worldwide. Our core markets include petrochemical, steel, aluminum, non-ferrous metals, energy, waste incineration, ceramics and glass.

Our portfolio covers the full range of refractory products and services, including thermal seals, refractory pre-shapes, and passive fire protection systems, all from a single source.

We are VCA certified, ISO 9001:2015 compliant, and audited according to NEN 4400-1, ensuring the highest standards in quality, safety, and compliance.

Your Role

You will take ownership of both operational HR tasks and strategic HR initiatives, working closely with management to strengthen our organization and people development.

HR Strategy & Policies


  • Develop and improve HR policies across the group

  • Advise management on HR-related topics

HR Administration

Your Profile

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. jobs.title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)

About the role

Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites.

Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.

We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.

Your role

You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to.

What you will do

  • Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

  • Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

  • Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

  • Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

  • Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

How we work

  • Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document.

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before.

  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design.

  • Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you.

  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field.

Requirements

  • You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field

  • You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)

  • You have built real hardware, not only modelled it

  • You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours

  • You understand design for manufacturing

  • You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want

Helpful, not required

  • Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM)

  • Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites

  • Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures

  • Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio

  • Rendering and visual design

  • Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware

  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Benefits

  • Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments

  • Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon

  • Flexible hours around lectures and exams

  • Compensation: €16–20 per hour

  • 6-month contract with the option to extend

  • Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow

  • Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments

  • Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Days without hands-on work can be done from our Hamburg HafenCity HQ

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min, remote): who you are, why Datacept

  2. Project conversation (45 min): bring what you built (CAD, photos, parts), and we start with a small design challenge right away

  3. Final meeting in person at our workshop in Horneburg with the founders

  4. Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

We have raised pre-seed capital and are backed by German federal funding. We work with critical infrastructure operators, defence agencies, and NATO partners to give Europe the intelligence we need in the electromagnetic spectrum.

jobs.description:
Senior Cyber Security Specialist

Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Problem You'll Solve

As a Senior Cyber Specialist, you'll be part of Prosus' Global Cyber team, helping our businesses identify, understand and manage their most critical cyber and technology risks.

You'll work across a diverse portfolio of businesses, delivering hands-on security testing, advisory and assurance projects that strengthen security.

You will use AI natively in everything you do. Your work will span a broad range of cybersecurity and technology domains, including:

  • Delivering cyber risk assessments, security reviews and controls testing across complex technology environments.

  • Conducting red teaming exercises and long-term Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) simulations to identify vulnerabilities and test organisational resilience.

  • Assessing cloud infrastructure, data platforms, DevOps environments and CI/CD pipelines to identify security weaknesses and opportunities for improvement.

  • Designing and facilitating cyber crisis simulations to test business preparedness and incident response capabilities.

  • Providing practical, constructive recommendations that help management strengthen security without slowing down innovation or business growth.

  • Partnering with technology and business leaders across our global portfolio to translate complex technical risks into meaningful business outcomes.

This is a full-time global role based in our Amsterdam (Zuidas) office, with up to 30% international travel.

Who You Are

  • A hands-on cybersecurity professional with strong technical specialist experience in offensive security, security engineering or red teaming. You enjoy getting into the technical detail, investigating threats and identifying weaknesses rather than focusing solely on governance, risk and compliance.

  • An AI and technology enthusiast who enjoys understanding how systems work, building harnesses and getting hands-on with complex technical environments.

  • Comfortable navigating code, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments and modern technology architectures.

  • Entrepreneurial in your mindset, with exposure to both fast-moving start-ups and larger, more mature IT organisations, not afraid to use AI to get the job done.

  • A confident communicator who can build trusted relationships, tell compelling stories and translate technical concepts into clear business language.

  • Equally comfortable engaging with CTOs, CIOs, security leaders, architects, developers and system administrators.

  • A global mindset, with interests beyond technology and an openness to travelling internationally, including to less conventional destinations.

What You Bring

  • 3–7 years of relevant professional experience in cybersecurity, with a strong technical foundation in offensive security, threat intelligence, red teaming or related disciplines.

  • Practical experience conducting or supporting penetration tests, security assessments, adversary simulations, threat investigations or other offensive security activities.

  • Hands on work with AI harnesses and offensive AI models.

  • Experience working with cloud technologies, data platforms and modern software engineering environments.

  • Experience working across different organisational environments, ideally including both entrepreneurial and more established technology businesses.

  • Relevant certifications such as CEH, OSCP, CISSP, CISM or CISA are welcome, but we value practical technical expertise and hands-on experience over certifications alone.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. jobs.description:
Staff Product Design Engineer — Data

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About us

Fever is the leading global live-entertainment discovery platform, helping millions of people every month find and enjoy the best experiences in their cities. We combine technology, data and creativity to power experiences in hundreds of cities worldwide, and we work with creators and partners to bring them to life.

The Data and AI team sits at the core of Fever's data-driven philosophy, driving how Fever makes rigorous decisions and builds bleeding-edge technology. We are growing a new group of Design Engineers who will design and build across all of Fever's products, from B2C to B2B, using data to guide every decision and making those products not just correct, but delightful, fast and genuinely useful.

About the role

Think. Design. Build. If that's how you like to work, this role could be for you.

As a Design Engineer you'll shape Fever products end to end, from B2C to B2B: understanding the problem, defining the solution and designing it with real craft. Some projects will end in a polished design. In others, the right call is to take it into code, whether that's a working prototype or a production-ready feature you ship yourself. You'll move comfortably across both, choosing what each problem needs.

What you'll do

  • Work on high-impact projects across Fever: discovery surfaces like the feed and our AI-powered assistant, critical reports and data-driven decision-making tools for our partners and internal teams, immersive funnels, and innovative initiatives that drive the business and raise the quality of our products.
  • Frame problems with users and PMs, decide what's worth building and validate your own hypotheses with data (SQL, dashboards, metrics).
  • Design and prototype interfaces for any Fever product, from B2C to B2B, with a high bar for craft.
  • When it makes sense, take your designs into code, from working prototypes to production-ready features, and work with engineers through GitHub, development and production environments.
  • Use AI as part of your everyday workflow to explore more ideas, prototype and move faster.

About you

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in product design, with a strong background and solid knowledge of front-end development.
  • Product thinker: you know what building product means, starting from user problems, business needs and impact rather than features, and you can explain your trade-offs.
  • Designer with taste: a polished eye and elevated craft, shown in a portfolio that also explains the thinking behind the work.
  • Strong front-end: solid HTML/CSS, responsive layouts and design systems, plus JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as React. You feel at home with Git, pull requests and dev/prod environments.
  • Data-fluent: you're comfortable using SQL, dashboards and metrics to test your ideas and make decisions.
  • Technologist: you love technology and building software, and you always want to understand the why behind things.
  • AI-native with judgment: you've adopted AI as a superpower, not an obligation. You verify what it produces, protect sensitive data and never ship code you don't understand.
  • You read "think, design and build" and think: that's me.
  • A portfolio is required. Please share one that shows your product thinking, your design craft and the things you've built, including front-end work where relevant. Applications without a portfolio won't be considered.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing data-heavy products or building with LLMs.
  • Side projects that show what you build for fun.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible schedule
  • Bonus
  • Stock options
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Health insurance from Day 1
  • English or Spanish Lessons
  • Wellhub Membership
  • Cobee (tax free allowance on restaurants and transport)
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

The Strategic Finance, Planning & Analysis team drives financial performance management across Prosus's global ecosystems - partnering with operating companies and Group Finance to ensure targets are met and capital is deployed effectively. The EU ecosystem team sits at the centre of Prosus's ambition to build a leading lifestyle e-commerce platform in Europe, and this Director role is the financial engine behind that ambition.

You'll own the full Strategic FP&A function for Prosus's European portfolio, managing the annual budgeting, planning, and forecasting cycle across a multi-entity, multi-country ecosystem, and leading the operating cadences that keep business unit CFOs, ecosystem leads, and Group Finance aligned. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

What You'll Do

Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy

  • Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
  • Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
  • Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

Build Data-Driven Fraud Products

  • Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
  • Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
  • Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
  • Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
  • Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

Lead Product Execution

  • Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
  • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.
  • Partner with Engineering to understand Tala’s fraud and authentication infrastructure and identify opportunities to improve scalability and reliability.
  • Drive initiatives from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

Manage Fraud & Risk Events

  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Operations to investigate fraud incidents and emerging fraud patterns.
  • Turn lessons from fraud events into proactive product and system improvements.
  • Develop approaches that allow Tala to respond quickly as fraud patterns and attack vectors evolve.

Collaborate Across Tala

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, and Legal.
  • Communicate complex fraud and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors and technology partners supporting fraud, authentication, identity, or risk capabilities.
  • Create alignment across distributed global teams and drive decisions in an environment where information may be incomplete or ambiguous.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with experience owning complex technical products or platforms.
  • Proven experience building or managing products related to fraud, risk, authentication, identity, KYC, account security, payments, lending, or financial crime.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science to build fraud detection, risk decisioning, authentication, or identity solutions.
  • Experience using data and metrics to make product decisions and measure outcomes.
  • Experience managing fraud incidents, emerging fraud patterns, or other high-impact risk events.
  • Ability to translate complex and ambiguous problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
  • Experience managing external vendors or technology partners.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, distributed, and highly collaborative environment.

Compensation

About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. AV Industry Expert (German-speaking)

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

The Netherlands is Rentman's biggest customer base, and DACH is our second-biggest. As an Implementation Specialist (German-speaking) on our Professional Services team, you make sure our German-speaking customers get the same excellent, hands-on support as everyone else.

You are the solution expert who helps customers realize the full value of Rentman. You deliver paid trainings to existing customers that accelerate onboarding, boost account health and broaden usage across teams. Everything comes from our standardized service catalogue: the offering is standard, the application is tailored to each customer. These services come on top of what every Rentman customer already gets free of charge: support, the support center and for some a dedicated CSM.

When you're not delivering customer trainings, you help the wider team stay useful year-round: you build standardized video trainings based on the most common questions coming out of our support center, and you're available to represent Rentman at customer events or trade shows in German-speaking markets.

  • Deliver at least 60% of your time as direct, standardized-but-tailored training to customers, one-on-one or in groups.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Nice)
jobs.description:
Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Nice)

Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term. This role is remote-based in Nice, France, with occasional travel to our Paris office.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. You will be responsible for driving growth, product adoption, and stakeholder management within your portfolio, with the goal of building true business partnerships. You will leverage data, customer feedback, and your SaaS expertise to create value at the enterprise level, while collaborating closely with teams across the business.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for our largest and most strategic hospitality customers

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive growth, retention, and product adoption

  • Proactively work on increasing product usage and ensure Net Revenue Retention (NRR) grows across your portfolio

  • Plan and lead quarterly business reviews and success plans

  • Analyze usage data, go-live milestones, and health scores to identify and mitigate risks early

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with C-level and operational stakeholders, positioning Lightspeed as a long-term strategic partner

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

  • Collect customer feedback and proactively share it with relevant teams to identify product gaps and optimize the overall customer journey


What you bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Account Management or Strategic Customer Success within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with enterprise customers

  • A strong understanding of SaaS metrics (NRR, product adoption, expansion, renewals, churn) and the ability to use them to manage your portfolio

  • A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management

  • Experience managing complex, multi-level stakeholder structures and confidently engaging with C-level, operations, and technical teams

  • Fluent business-level French and English

  • Experience in the hospitality, POS, or hospitality tech industry is a plus, but not required


What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience…

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

  • Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Exposure to modern and proven technology

  • Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Elixir
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Elixir

Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

Location: Spain - 100% Home office friendly.

What are we looking for:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync.

What would you do at Fever?

In your first month at Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning, grooming, and retrospectives of the team, and you will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever’s tech stack: frameworks used to develop our applications, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure that support our operations.
  • You will have lots of Pull Requests merged and running in production.
  • You will attend some of the Fever Originals’ experiences, like Candlelight.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will be able to come up with solutions to new difficult problems, defining the solution from the architecture design to its implementation.
  • You will continue creating production-grade Python code designed to handle high levels of traffic, measuring the outcome of the functionalities and improving the product.
  • You will participate in some of the hackdays or hackathons we organise with other teams, and you will mostly know everybody from engineering.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • You will have responsibilities over different parts of the systems, analysing the usage from the users and evolving the platform to meet the users’ needs.

Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
Customer Success Lead

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool - what does a Customer Success Lead have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs and is growing fast in secondary care. To keep up with how the NHS is organising itself, our Account Management team has just moved to a regional model, with leads for London, the South and the North. The goal is simple: join up what we’re learning across primary care, secondary care, acute, community and mental health, and make sure the best opportunities get surfaced across the whole of England, not just in one set of ICBs.

We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead for the North. You’ll lead a team of Customer Success Managers across primary and secondary care and be the strategic, zoomed-out view of the region. Your team is close to the accounts. Your job is to spot the patterns across them, turn what they’re hearing into strategy, and help Accurx show up at a regional level.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Lead

  • Lead and grow a team of CSMs. You’ll start with three CSMs, each with their own region, customers and stage of the customer journey. You’ll coach them, unblock them and help them do the best work of their careers.

  • Bring two very different care settings together. Primary care is about deepening trust we’ve built over years. Secondary care is about firsts: new services, longer implementations and goalposts that move. You’ll work out what connects them, what doesn’t, and where learnings from one can speed up the other.

  • Turn insight into strategy. Your team will feed you what’s happening on the ground. You’ll spot trends, gaps and duplicated effort across the region and turn them into projects, goals and growth opportunities in products like Accurx Scribe and Total Triage.

  • Own the commercial picture for your region. You’ll keep a close eye on churn, risk, renewals and upsell across your team’s accounts, and represent the region at our weekly business reviews with the exec team.

  • Build the playbook with your fellow leads. The regional model is brand new. Alongside the leads for London and the South, you’ll shape how we work, what best practice looks like and how we scale it.

  • Be the link across the business. You’ll work closely with implementation, transformation, support and business development, making sure the voice of our customers shapes where Accurx goes next.


You should apply if...

  • You’ve led customer-facing teams. You have a few years of people management in customer success or account management, and you love helping others grow.

  • You’ve built things from the ground up. You’ve been on a startup to scale-up journey, worn a lot of hats, and taken customers from never having heard of you to being your biggest advocates.

  • You care about depth, not volume. You’ve looked after long-standing, strategic relationships rather than a high-volume queue, and you know that trust is what makes customers stick.

  • You can zoom out. You don’t need to be in the weeds of every account. You’re great at spotting patterns, asking the right questions and knowing where your team needs you most.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You’re happy to try something, get it wrong, learn and go again. Process is something you create, not something you wait for.

  • You’re a big collaborator. You’re an incredible communicator and listener, and you know the best outcomes come from working across teams.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Healthcare experience is welcome but not essential. What matters is empathy for the pressure the NHS is under and the patience to build trust in a complex system.


What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £70,000 - £90,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £30,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £70K – £90K

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.description:
SailPoint Identity (IIQ) Senior Developer / Engineer

Job Title: SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) Senior Developer / Engineer

Experience: 8–12 Years

Location: Germany / EU Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Work Mode: Remote

Role Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) Senior Developer / Engineer with 8–12 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) to design, build, and support enterprise-scale identity solutions. This role focuses on hands-on development and integration in SailPoint IIQ, delivering access governance, lifecycle management, joiner-mover-leaver (JML) processes, and compliance controls across diverse applications and directories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead design and development of SailPoint IdentityIQ solutions (workflows, rules, forms, certifications, policies, identity lifecycle events).

  • Develop and enhance integrations/connectors with target systems (AD/Azure AD, LDAP, databases, HR systems, SaaS applications) using IIQ connectors, Web Services (REST/SOAP), and custom provisioning logic.

  • Implement and optimize JML processes, access request, approvals, provisioning/deprovisioning, and role/entitlement management.

  • Configure and customize governance features including access certifications, access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), policy violations, and reporting.

  • Build and maintain IIQ artifacts: Identity Cubes, Applications, Managed Attributes, Roles, Policies, LCM configurations, and Identity Profiles.

  • Create and maintain custom rules (BeanShell/Java), workflows, and task schedules; troubleshoot and resolve issues in lower environments and production.

  • Own end-to-end delivery: requirements analysis, technical design, development, unit testing, deployment, and hypercare.

  • Support upgrades, patching, and environment migrations; assess impact, remediate customizations, and validate functionality post-upgrade.

  • Collaborate with IAM architects, security, infrastructure, and application teams to define standards, patterns, and roadmaps.

  • Drive engineering quality: code reviews, documentation, CI/CD practices, and performance tuning.

  • Provide Level 3 support, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement for IAM services and operational processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–12 years of overall IT experience, with strong hands-on experience in SailPoint IdentityIQ development and implementation.

  • Solid understanding of IAM concepts: authentication vs authorization, identity lifecycle, access governance, RBAC/ABAC, SoD, least privilege.

  • Strong development skills with Java and/or BeanShell, and the ability to debug code effectively.

  • Experience building integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, JDBC/SQL, flat files, and directory services (LDAP/Active Directory).

  • Experience with IIQ LCM, Access Requests, Provisioning, Workflows, Rules, Forms, Roles, Certifications, and Policies.

  • Working knowledge of IdentityIQ deployment models, environment setup, and production support practices.

  • Familiarity with source control and build/deploy processes (e.g., Git, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins/Azure DevOps).

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including log analysis, performance considerations, and root-cause analysis.

  • Ability to translate functional requirements into technical designs and deliver with minimal supervision.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SailPoint IdentityIQ certification(s) or equivalent IAM certification(s).

  • Experience with SailPoint IdentityNow, PAM tools, or IGA platforms (Saviynt, Okta IGA, etc.).

  • Experience with cloud IAM patterns and integrations (Azure AD, AWS IAM/SSO, Google Workspace).

  • Experience implementing SoD policies and compliance controls for frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, or GDPR.

  • Hands-on experience with DevSecOps practices, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code (where applicable).

  • Experience with ITSM processes/tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and on-call/production support.

Technical Skills (Core)

  • SailPoint IdentityIQ: LCM, certification campaigns, role model, policies, workflows, rules, task scheduling, reporting, troubleshooting

  • Languages: Java, BeanShell; scripting (PowerShell/Python) is a plus

  • Integrations: REST/SOAP, JDBC/SQL, LDAP/AD, Azure AD

  • Platforms/Tools: Tomcat, application servers, Linux/Windows basics, Git, CI/CD pipelines

  • Security: RBAC, least privilege, auditability, access review controls

jobs.title: (Junior) Data Engineer | Knowledge Graphs & Pharma Data (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
(Junior) Data Engineer | Knowledge Graphs & Pharma Data (f/m/d)

Become a Part of Accurids

Join us and help make medicinal product data useful for all!

At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our platform identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in line with global standards such as the ISO standard for the Identification of Medicinal Products (IDMP), and some of the world's largest pharma companies use it to bring products to patients faster and more safely.

You will join our Services department, a group of interdisciplinary experts who help our pharma customers adopt our platform and make it truly useful for their data. Within it, you are part of the data engineering team, which works in a clear, well-documented way: state-of-the-art tools, flexible processes, and agentic AI used in a structured, reliable way. You see your results in live customer projects within weeks, and learn the pharma data domain from people who have worked in it for years.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • You transform data from a wide range of structured sources (such as CSV, JSON, RDF, and SQL and NoSQL databases) into the IDMP data model, and build the pipelines that keep it up to date.
  • You use AI to turn unstructured sources such as documents and texts into structured, verifiable data.
  • You bring a DevOps mindset to data: with AI as your everyday tool, used responsibly, you keep data flows and tooling tested, automated, documented and reliable, as the regulated pharma industry demands.
  • You support the design of data models for IDMP knowledge graphs, leveraging the IDMP ontology, and learn to navigate graphs with SPARQL and agentic tooling.
  • As part of a joint team with our customers, you work directly with their domain experts to understand their data and make their medicinal product data useful.

What helps you succeed:

  • A background in computer science, data science or a life-science subject such as biology, chemistry or pharmacy. A formal degree is welcome but not required.
  • First hands-on experience in data engineering, data transformation or data preparation.
  • You understand how software and data systems fit together and can read and judge code, whether you or an AI wrote it.
  • Experience with version control (e.g. Git) and working in a team where changes are reviewed.
  • You communicate clearly with your team and with customers.
  • You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit.
  • Business-fluent English. German is a plus.
  • Coding experience in any language is a bonus. What matters to us is that you understand how programs work, not which language you learned it in.
  • It's a plus if you have worked with RDF, SPARQL or knowledge graphs, have experience with AI-based information extraction, know the basics of data governance, or bring knowledge of the pharma domain and/or IDMP.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Salary range of €50,000 to €80,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • Hybrid work from our office in the KölnTurm with a view over the city and free parking
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Personal learning budget for trainings, conferences and certifications
  • Your choice of a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a City Plus Card with €50 per month
  • Hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux or Windows)
  • A team of around 20 people with short decision paths, where your work is visible from day one
  • A structured onboarding, together with other new colleagues starting at the same time

Not ticking every box?

Apply anyway! We care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn than about a perfect checklist.

At Accurids we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented groups in tech, science and data to apply.

jobs.description:
Principal Software Developer (f/m/d) - Market Data

Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency, and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!

Job Overview

Our Market Data team forms an essential link between our business and infrastructure teams: it defines and implements business processes in data pipelines, monitors existing services, and thereby provides the best service to our customers. As a Senior Software Developer in our Market Data team, you will be working on a broad set of real-world problems. Highly effective data management, resilience, and fail-over strategies are some of our most important topics. In close collaboration with our business analysts and data engineers, you will create high-performance data processing solutions that scale using emerging technologies and approaches and help us define new best practices.

Our continuous business growth and high requirements on accuracy, performance, and availability will provide you with a lot of engineering challenges and opportunities to contribute, to learn, and to grow as part of our team.

You love solving complex problems, building performant, scalable, low latency, and highly available services. Then we can’t wait to meet you!

Your Tasks

  • Designing and implementing challenging projects to develop our data processing pipeline.
  • Building up a data landscape that acts as the single source of all relevant data in the long run.
  • Engineering ETL processes.
  • Developing high performance APIs and streaming solutions to our clients and data vendors.
  • Being an in-house consultant for best track, store, and access data.

Your Profile

  • 8+ years of software development, data engineering, or relevant experience, including at least 5 years of in-depth Python experience.
  • Software Engineering: good understanding of microservice architectures, Liskov’s Substitution Principle, design patterns, and dynamic dispatch.
  • Databases: experience with at least one SQL/NoSQL database, such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including schema definition and evolution, as well as ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy, JPA, or Hibernate.
  • Cloud / Cloud-native development: Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • CI/CD: ability to define build pipelines and perform, validate, and monitor deployments.
  • Good understanding of microservice architectures.
  • Ability to define Docker images according to the Twelve-Factor App methodology.
  • Git: ability to use Git from the command line and apply version-control management practices (e.g., Gitflow, trunk-based development).
  • Strong technical mentoring skills.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Communication: ability to illustrate ideas and concepts with figurative examples to both stakeholders and developers.
  • Ability to perceive the business domain in terms of mathematical structures is appreciated.

Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family, a motivated team with an international setting.
  • Get to know the dynamics of an established, successful FinTech company.
  • Free choice of your gears to work comfortably and effectively.
  • Experience a modern start-up culture with a flat hierarchy.
  • Seize the opportunity to develop personally, take over responsibility and maintain direct customer contact from day one.
  • Flexible work environment with a hybrid work model and 30 annual vacation days.
  • Receive numerous benefits (e.g. Regular staff parties, team events, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space, activity room, free beverages and fruit baskets).

jobs.description:
Security Architect

Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) 

  • Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) 

What we offer you 

  

💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 

🏦 Excellent pension contribution. 

🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. 

⏰ Flexible working hours. 

🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 

🏋️ Free onsite gym. 

🎉 Vibrant, open culture.

jobs.description:
B2B Marketing - India

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 

What you'll do

  • Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

  • Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

  • Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Indian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

  • Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

  • Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

 

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

  • Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

  • Deep knowledge of the Indian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

  • Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

  • Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

  • Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out.
