jobs.title: Business Development Manager in a disruptive scale-up: be a changemaker and learn to build a company
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager in a disruptive scale-up: be a changemaker and learn to build a company

(Offices: Berlin, Frankfurt)

As Business Development Manager guide enterprise clients in changing their business, using our AI-powered go-to-market

Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies, “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received €20 million in Series A financing round.

Vicos consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e.g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of members work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Capgemini. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new way of organizing human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers all essential areas end-to-end: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Why we are looking for you

We are scaling our go-to-market, AI-first and human-led: AI takes over the busywork, people build the relationships and make the decisions. For that we look for people with a builder’s mindset: you have already built or significantly contributed to something, you work with AI as naturally as with email, and you want to grow fast. Maybe you want to found your own company one day.

With us you learn how a disruptive business grows by challenging established practices and offering radically new, superior solutions: from the first contact to the signed contract and the team that delivers. You work on real enterprise deals from the start and take on more responsibility as you grow.

What you do

• Expand our business: Together with our Chief Growth Officer (your boss) and colleagues, you guide new and existing clients in shifting their supply of services to Vicos. You identify prospects, understand their potential to improve through Vicos and lead them in starting and expanding their work with Vicos. You prepare client meetings, join them with our senior team and Vico Leads (the Vicos’ bosses) and take over your own accounts step by step.

• Represent Vicoland at events: Together with Vico Leads and senior colleagues (and increasingly on your own) you attend industry events (conferences, trade fairs etc.). You prepare and execute Vicoland’s event communication aimed at building reputation, raising client interest, and deepening relationships.

• Spot and seize opportunities: You are always on the lookout for ways to win new clients or grow business with existing ones: through new channels, new partnerships or ideas nobody has tried yet. You do not wait for assignments or permission: you bring facts and a proposal, act, and measure what works.

• Build and run our AI-powered go-to-market: You use, improve and build AI workflows and agents for research, outreach, meeting preparation and content, e.g. with Claude and its connectors to HubSpot, our platform and our wiki. You test new tools and roll out what delivers the best results and keeps us authentic. You share what works as a use case and help turn it into team standards.

• Develop Vicos: You work closely with Vico Leads to make sure our offer matches client demand. This includes support in finding new members or AI agents for Vicos, doing the research, communication and meetings needed. You help Vico Leads to onboard new members, integrate new AI agents, sharpen their profiles and win projects.

• Influence the market and the company: You create content for LinkedIn and our website incl. blog and you bring back what you learn in the market to improve how we work.

Who you are

• You have an academic degree, for example in business, engineering, computer science, natural sciences, law or another field. Your subject matters less than your mindset and what you have made of your life so far.

• You have some professional experience in which you learned and contributed significantly. All the better if this experience involved innovating established practices and included communication responsibilities. This may have been in diverse fields, for example consulting sales, business development, finance or technology, be it in large organizations, SMEs or startups. The experience may have been gained in regular employment, internships, or working student jobs.

• You have built something, alone or together, for example a startup, a student initiative, a sales pipeline, a charity, an AI tool … or anything else that did not exist before and is useful to others.

• You use AI every day and like to build your own workflows. Coding skills are a plus.

• You are creative, take initiative, work in a structured way and finish what you start.

• You enjoy working with people and build trust quickly.

• You are curious about enterprise technology.

• You speak German and English fluently.

Whether you are at the start of your career or already have a few years of experience: we shape the role around what you bring.

What we offer

• Compensation: A fixed salary, a variable component tied to your commercial success, and company shares (ESOP).

• Responsibility: Real responsibility from day one and direct work with our CGO and CEO.

• Learning: A steep learning curve in enterprise sales, AI and company building.

• Path to entrepreneurship: If you want to build your own company later, you can build your own Vico with our backing.

• Flexibility: Hybrid work from Berlin or Frankfurt, with further offices in Barcelona and Seville.

• Team: A highly talented team with diverse backgrounds.

Ready to start?

Then let's talk. Skip the cover letter and self-descriptions: get in touch and show us what you have done. We start with a conversation, not a formal application. Apply with the button on this page. Or get in touch with Marc Kutschera on LinkedIn.

jobs.description:
Sr. Compliance Consultant

About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Compliance Consultant to help our clients navigate regulatory change, horizon-scan upcoming regulation, and overcome regulatory challenges so they can transform their businesses and meet their strategic growth objectives.

This is a versatile, high-impact role at the intersection of regulation, client advisory, practical delivery and product strategy. Your mission is to deeply understand our clients’ needs and regulatory obligations, and to deliver solutions that help them achieve their compliance and business outcomes. You’ll stay ahead of the risk and compliance landscape, translating regulatory change into clear guidance for our customers and concrete requirements for our Product team.

Whether you’re shaping a client’s regulatory strategy or influencing our product roadmap, you’ll bring deep knowledge and hands-on experience of financial crime compliance, along with strong commercial awareness. Acting as an in-house consultant, you’ll connect long-term regulatory horizons with granular operational realities.

 

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move comfortably between complex challenges, and have the judgement to turn them into sharp, practical solutions. You’ll also work on long-horizon strategic projects, such as building government relationships and expanding Condukt’s global data footprint, where progress is measured in weeks, not months.

If you thrive in dynamic environments where no two days look the same, enjoy tackling a constant stream of new and complex problems, and want to help shape how financial institutions and fintechs approach compliance, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Act as Condukt’s subject matter expert on KYB/KYC and AML/CFT, giving clients clear, commercially minded advice on their regulatory obligations

  • Lead client engagements end to end, from understanding the business challenge and assessing current controls to designing solutions that combine Condukt’s platform with third-party providers and supporting their implementation

  • Produce high-quality, client-ready deliverables, such as gap analyses, risk assessments, onboarding and monitoring frameworks, policies and decision papers

  • Run workshops with client stakeholders, from compliance teams to the C-suite, turning discussion into practical next steps

  • Horizon-scan regulation across the UK, Europe and beyond, and brief clients on what’s coming and what it means for them, directly or alongside our commercial team

  • Advise clients on their compliance stack, testing and benchmarking providers through structured, RFP-style evaluations

  • Build and maintain relationships with regulators, government bodies and company registers to secure access to data, expand Condukt’s global footprint and represent Condukt in industry forums

  • Shape Condukt’s advisory proposition, identifying emerging client needs and opportunities to bring new capabilities to existing clients alongside our commercial team

  • Partner with Product to translate regulatory and client needs into the signals, data and capabilities we build

  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership with a clear, well-argued point of view on regulation, through proposals, client pitches, whitepapers, briefings, webinars and industry events

 

What you bring:

  • 4+ years’ experience in financial crime compliance, gained in a consultancy, a regulator or a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep domain expertise in risk and compliance, ideally across KYB/KYC, AML/CFT or business onboarding in financial services

  • A track record of advising financial institutions and fintechs on risk, compliance or regulatory matters, with a toolkit of structured frameworks you can adapt to a fast-growing company

  • Experience leading client engagements and producing polished, client-ready deliverables

  • Experience advising on vendor assessment and selection, including running or contributing to RFP processes

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite stakeholders, regulators and government agencies

  • Strong commercial awareness: you can turn regulatory requirements into solutions clients see real value in

  • A legal background, or solid working knowledge of financial regulation and how legislation translates into operational requirements

  • Sound judgement and tact in sensitive situations: you know what to communicate, to whom and when

  • The analytical rigour to dig into complex legislation and question established interpretations

  • A self-starter mindset that thrives in fast-moving, high-ownership environments

Bonus:

  • Experience in government relations or regulatory affairs

  • Prior experience in fintech, banking, payments or compliance infrastructure

  • Early-stage startup experience

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

L'entreprise compte parmi les leaders mondiaux de son secteur et dessert des fabricants de parfums, de cosmétiques, de produits alimentaires et de boissons, ainsi que l'industrie pharmaceutique et les producteurs de compléments nutritionnels et d'aliments pour animaux.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) au Secrétaire Général, avec un rattachement fonctionnel au Regional Head of Safety EAME, vous définissez, pilotez et faites évoluer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy.

Véritable partenaire de la Direction du site et des responsables opérationnels, vous veillez à intégrer pleinement les enjeux EHS aussi bien dans les activités quotidiennes que dans les projets de transformation, de développement et d'investissement du site.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

  • Définir et déployer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy, en cohérence avec les objectifs EHS globaux de Symrise et les priorités du business.

  • Manager et développer l'équipe EHS, en définissant les priorités et en veillant à disposer des compétences et ressources nécessaires.

  • Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les principaux risques environnementaux, santé et sécurité, et assurer la mise en œuvre de plans de prévention adaptés.

  • Développer une véritable culture de la sécurité et de la prévention auprès de l'ensemble des activités du site : laboratoires, bureaux et fonctions support.

  • Accompagner la Direction dans ses prises de décision en apportant votre expertise sur les risques EHS, les contraintes réglementaires et leurs impacts opérationnels.

  • Intégrer les exigences EHS dès les premières étapes des projets de transformation, immobiliers, laboratoires et de développement du site.

  • Piloter la conformité réglementaire et anticiper les évolutions de la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'EHS susceptibles d'impacter les activités du site.

  • Développer et entretenir des relations constructives avec les autorités et parties prenantes externes, notamment l'Inspection du travail, la CRAMIF, les services de santé au travail ainsi que les autorités environnementales et locales.

  • Représenter le site lors des inspections et audits réglementaires et assurer le suivi des plans d'action associés.

  • Piloter les analyses d'incidents et garantir la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives et préventives durables.

  • Suivre la performance EHS, les indicateurs clés et le reporting associé, dans une logique d'amélioration continue.

  • Être l'interface privilégiée entre le site de Clichy et les équipes EHS régionales et globales de Symrise.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Hygiène, Sécurité et Environnement (HSE/EHS), sciences environnementales, ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe.

Vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience progressive dans une fonction EHS, idéalement acquise au sein d'une organisation internationale et dans des environnements complexes combinant activités industrielles, laboratoires ou opérations.

Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons un profil capable d'allier vision stratégique et pragmatisme opérationnel.

Vous vous distinguez notamment par :

  • Une solide expertise en management EHS, évaluation des risques et conformité réglementaire.

  • Une expérience confirmée dans le management et le développement d'équipes EHS.

  • Une expérience significative dans l'accompagnement de projets de transformation, de développement ou d'investissement.

  • Une bonne maîtrise des relations avec les autorités réglementaires et les parties prenantes externes.

  • Une capacité à anticiper les risques et à transformer des problématiques EHS complexes en recommandations concrètes et pragmatiques pour le business.

  • De solides compétences en leadership, en influence et en accompagnement du changement dans une organisation matricielle et internationale.

  • Une excellente capacité à communiquer et à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment avec le senior management.

  • De fortes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'aide à la décision.

  • Une expérience en conduite du changement et en gouvernance de projets.

  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais.

Avantages

Ce poste vous offre l'opportunité de prendre la responsabilité des enjeux EHS au sein d'un site stratégique de Symrise, en collaboration étroite avec la Direction locale ainsi qu'avec les équipes régionales et globales du Groupe.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement en transformation, où l'EHS joue un rôle essentiel dans la continuité des activités, le développement du site, l'excellence opérationnelle et la croissance durable.

Au-delà des enjeux de conformité, vous aurez l'opportunité de façonner la feuille de route EHS du site de Clichy, d'influencer des décisions structurantes et de contribuer directement au développement d'une culture forte et proactive de la sécurité.

Localisation : Clichy (92)
Intitulé : EHS Manager – Site de Clichy

Rémunération

La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de EUR 60,000–72,000 par an.

Vos premiers mois chez Symrise

Vous prenez en main la gestion des dossiers HSE du site de Clichy et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles. Votre période d'essai de 3 mois vous permet de vous familiariser avec nos standards de sécurité et nos exigences réglementaires. Vous disposez de 25 jours de congés payés par an pour organiser votre équilibre personnel.

jobs.description:
Account Executive - Enterprise I Paris

About us

Procurement is overdue for a reset. For years, procurement and accounting teams have been stuck on legacy platforms that are now trying to bolt AI onto decades-old architecture. The rest of the enterprise tech stack is speeding companies up, and procurement is still slowing them down.

Pivot is the AI-native intake-to-pay platform built to change that. It’s the procurement platform people across the business actually use, so adoption sticks, cycle times drop, and finance sees spend before it’s committed, not after. And because Pivot touches every team in a purchase, accounting teams can finally fully automate their boring tasks.

The adventure started mid-2023 with three founders, former C-levels from fintech unicorns (Qonto, Swile, and Nuxeo).

We’ve built a team of 70 operating across 25+ countries. Backed by $70M from tier-1 investors and trusted by DoorDash, Lemonade, Wolt and Flix, we’ve just moved into the enterprise, and we’re only getting started.


We're looking for smart, execution-driven people who care about building something exceptional.

Your role

As an Account Executive - Enterprise, you will own the full sales cycle for our most strategic accounts on the French and Belgium market. You will target large, complex organisations with multiple stakeholders, navigate sophisticated procurement and legal processes, and close high-value, long-term deals that define Pivot's enterprise footprint in EMEA.

You will join our Sales team, which currently includes a VP of Revenue, Account Executives, a Pre-Sales Engineer, and a BDR team. You will report directly to VP of Revenue.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from first contact through close, managing procurement, legal, IT, and C-suite stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan targeting strategic enterprise accounts across your defined region, in close coordination with the BDR team. Willing to open doors by your own methods too.

  • Build and deliver compelling business cases, executive-level presentations, and tailored demos that articulate Pivot's value at every stage of the buying journey.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, structure commercial agreements, and ensure favourable terms for both Pivot and clients, building win-win partnerships designed to last.

  • Identify and drive expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts, surfacing upsell and cross-sell potential to grow revenue and deepen relationships.

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline: own your forecast with accuracy on a monthly and quarterly basis, and manage CRM hygiene in HubSpot.

  • Collaborate internally:

    • Work closely with the BDR team, providing direction, feedback, and mentorship to maximise the quality and volume of enterprise pipeline.

    • Partner with Pre-Sales to manage technical evaluations, RFPs, and InfoSec requirements during complex sales cycles.

    • Coordinate with the Operations team to ensure smooth handoffs and long-term client satisfaction post-close.

Your sales mindset

  • You are a master of enterprise sales cycles: multi-threaded stakeholder management and driving consensus across large, complex organisations come naturally to you.

  • You are a strategic thinker who approaches your territory like a business: mapping white space, prioritising high-potential accounts, and building plans to convert them methodically over time.

  • You are confident and credible at C-suite level, able to engage procurement directors and CFOs.

  • You are resilient and persistent: long sales cycles don't discourage you. You manage momentum, keep deals alive, and know how to re-engage accounts that have gone quiet.

  • You are naturally curious and want to actively solve customer problems.

  • You are commercially sharp, able to understand complex pricing structures and articulate ROI and TCO in a way that resonates with financially-driven buyers.

  • You are a collaborative leader who uplifts those around you: sharing knowledge with BDRs, working closely with pre-sales, and contributing to a culture of high performance.

  • You like solving problems and making complex things look simple.

  • You always want to keep learning and you are comfortable with confronting ideas.

  • You enjoy the cadence and want to bring the best of yourself within an early-staged startup.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing enterprise-level deals.

  • Demonstrated success selling to enterprise accounts (1,000+ employees), managing multi-stakeholder buying processes and complex procurement cycles.

  • Experience handling deals with ACV of £100k+ and sales cycles of 6–12+ months.

  • Native-level French, and Fluent-level English; additional languages (German, Spanish) are a strong plus.

  • Highly organised, data-driven, and comfortable operating autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

  • Based in Paris; comfortable with occasional travel across EMEA.

What you will get

  • A competitive salary package plus equity (BSPCE)

  • RTT

  • 1 days of remote work per week

  • An office at Morning Bourse in Paris

  • The richness of a multicultural and international team (more than 15 nationalities).

  • A unique chance to grow with a fast-scaling innovator

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer

About Us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the technical implementation of our AI search platform for some of the world's leading law firms. Every customer environment is different: from cloud-native deployments to complex on-premise infrastructure, enterprise identity providers, document management systems, and datasets containing hundreds of millions of documents. Your mission is to ensure customers successfully deploy, integrate, and adopt DeepJudge in their environments.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing engineering role that sits at the intersection of software engineering, infrastructure, and enterprise AI. You'll spend your time deploying software, solving complex integration and infrastructure challenges, troubleshooting production issues during customer implementations, and working directly with engineering teams to continuously improve the product and deployment experience. You'll collaborate closely with Sales Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering to make every deployment faster, more reliable, and easier to operate. If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, working directly with customers, and seeing the impact of your work in production, this role is for you. No travel is required for this role.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical solution end to end, from architecture and hands-on implementation through production rollout and adoption, adapting DeepJudge to the customer's environment and needs along the way.

  • Deploying and configuring DeepJudge across cloud and on-premise customer environments.

  • Integrating DeepJudge with enterprise systems such as document management systems, identity providers, cloud platforms, and other data sources.

  • Troubleshooting complex issues across deployments, infrastructure, networking, authentication, integrations, and application behavior.

  • Building deployment automation, implementation tooling, documentation, and operational playbooks that make customer deployments faster, easier, and more scalable.

  • Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering to solve complex technical challenges and improve both the product and deployment experience.

  • Bringing recurring customer requirements and challenges back to the team and helping turn them into product and engineering improvements.

  • Taking ownership beyond your immediate projects: spotting what is missing, fixing what is broken, and helping us build the processes and tools we need as we scale.

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 3+ years of experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Forward Deployment, Solutions Engineering, or a similar technical role.

  • Have experience deploying or operating enterprise software in production environments.

  • Have experience with technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Azure or GCP.

  • Enjoy working directly with enterprise customers, building trusted technical relationships, and guiding complex implementation projects from kickoff to production.

  • Enjoy troubleshooting complex technical problems that span infrastructure, integrations, and application behavior.

  • Can communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Bonus: Experience with enterprise search, AI/LLM platforms, document management systems, Infrastructure as Code, or experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment


What you can look forward to:

  • Owning the deployment of AI systems that power knowledge discovery for some of the world's leading law firms.

  • Solving challenging engineering problems across enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, authentication systems, and large-scale data environments

  • Working closely with experienced engineers, product teams, and customers to shape both our platform and how it is deployed

  • A high-ownership engineering culture founded by ex-Google search engineers and ETH Zurich AI PhDs, where customer feedback directly influences the product

  • The opportunity to improve deployment tooling, automation, and operational processes as we scale globally

  • A collaborative team in Zurich shaping how AI transforms professional knowledge work.

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • Follow the session guidelines and moderator instructions

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Platform Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Netherlands.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

Anchor our system deliveries. Connect internal teams seamlessly – so our life-saving radars reach the front lines without delay.

  • Logistics coordination and internal handovers: Coordinate handovers with the Warehouse and Logistics crew with complete shipping files. Monitor dispatch statuses once Operations releases each radar system. Keep internal handovers structured, clean, and ready for physical freight execution.

Monitor administrative workflows proactively to eliminate handover bottlenecks and protect dispatch targets.

What you bring

  • Vocational degree (MBO Level 4 / Associate degree) or equivalent practical experience in administration, supply chain, or logistics

  • 3+ years of experience in administrative support, order processing, or logistics coordination, preferably within a high-tech manufacturing or hardware environment

  • Practical experience working with ERP systems and databases (experience with Odoo is a strong advantage)

  • Experience handling compliance or logistics paperwork, such as shipping manifests, export control documentation, or QA certificates

  • Strong command of English (both written and spoken) and working proficiency in Dutch is considered a strong asset

  • High attention to detail with a methodical approach to data accuracy and documentation

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills to handle multiple handovers efficiently

  • Collaborative, supportive mindset suited for cross-functional internal operations

What we offer

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

jobs.title: Integration Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Integration Test Engineer

Role - Integration Test Engineer

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht

About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. 

We are a fast-growing international team of driven and collaborative talents, from engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact: iwell is committed to form a diverse and inclusive team to tackle the challenges of the energy transition.  

The Role

The proof is in the pudding, they say in the UK, however, we believe proof is in the test data. All our systems and their interactions within the larger energy ecosystem are thoroughly tested. We are serving a diverse customer base with strict demands, our services power business and key infrastructure. We demand that our products are subjected to a wide range of testing during the integration and development phase. We're seeking a talented and curious test engineer with a passion for sustainability and battery energy storage. 

You will handle a wide variety of topics from different customer requirements and have a lot of freedom to develop the test methodology and strategy. You will work within the battery system team, where software and hardware come together in the products we develop for our customers.  We will rely on your experience, hands-on approach and judgment. You will be crucial in driving our mission of transitioning from fossil-fuel dependence. If you're passionate about sustainability and have the technical skills to bring our vision to life, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

  • Develop test campaigns based on internal and external requirements

  • Discuss and present test results internally and externally

  • Execute tests and document the result

  • Support the integration of hardware components into iwell’s BESS, ensuring compatibility and performance.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, such as system specifications,  processes, and instructions.

  • You will become one of the practical system experts within iwell, interacting with field service, product development and engineering teams.

What are looking for

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in electrical design of high power and energy conversion systems.

  • Knowledge of technical standards and grid operator connection requirements.

  • Able to make the basic design for a site with energy production and storage, feeding into the Medium Voltage AC grid, including cable system design, PE system design and according to national installation guidelines.

  • Strong communication skills and attention to quality assurance

  • Ability to read and produce technical drawings and schematics

  • Ability to speak and write German is a plus

Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary within the range of EUR 5,200 - 5,800 (plus 8% holiday allowance)

  • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

  • The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year

  • Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year 

  • Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day 

  • Working remotely for 2 weeks per year 

  • We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport.

  • A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month

  • Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc.

  • iwell is a family friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities

Interested?

For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/. 

Our application process

  1. Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks.

  2. Phone screening. Are you an iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call.

  3. Are you the one? You will have two or more interviews. For some roles, you will also be asked to work on a case.

DeepHealth is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner based in Europe to own high-impact, full-cycle recruiting across European markets and support global hiring as needed.   • Own full-cycle recruitment across multiple European markets, with additional support for US, Canadian, and APAC hiring as business needs require.

  • Lead detailed intake meetings to understand business objectives, essential competencies, technical requirements, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles for each distinct search.

  • Develop tailored sourcing and assessment strategies for niche and business-critical roles; proactively engage passive candidates through direct sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and professional networks.

jobs.title: Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d) Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team!

We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet.

We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates.

How we work:

  • Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies.
  • Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations.
  • AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs.
  • Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them.


Your responsibilities:

  • Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions.
  • Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal.
  • Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers.
  • Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments.
  • Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build.
  • Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn.


What you should bring:

  • At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar).
  • You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them.
  • Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state.
  • Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes.
  • You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests.
  • You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments.
  • Fluent German and English.


Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing.

Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates based in EU/EEA.

Why you should work at Famedly:

  • Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase. Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we're now bringing MLS-secured messaging to the public sector.
  • Meaningful ownership. Take responsibility for software people rely on every day in critical environments.
  • Deep technical work. Help build one of the first MLS deployments in the German public sector, on a protocol whose ecosystem is still taking shape.
  • Small, close-knit teams. Work in a small team with short decision paths.
  • Modern AI tooling. Use up-to-date coding agents and models without having to count tokens.
  • Your perfect work-life balance. With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space!
  • Attractive conditions. A permanent contract with competitive compensation, a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year.
  • Flexible Benefits with Probonio. You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club.
  • A diverse and international team. We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome.
  • Regular team events. Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit.


We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you!

Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now! We are excited to get to know you!

Instead of a cover letter, send us a link to something you've built (Rust preferred) and two or three sentences about how you work with coding agents.

Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Measurement

Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.


What You'll Do
  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.
  • Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.
  • Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.
  • Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.
  • Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.
  • Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.
  • Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.
  • Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

    • What You'll Bring
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.
  • Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.
  • Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.
  • Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).
  • Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.
  • Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.
  • Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team.
    • If you are interested in this position, please apply via the link.

    Why People Join Us

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

    Before You Hit Apply

Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Location Data engineer
jobs.description:
Location Data engineer

We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

  • Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A).

We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year:

  • 5 weeks of paid time off;

  • 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

  • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

Data Platform Engineer

About the role

At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog. It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company.

Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt, Airflow, S3, AWS, Superset, and GitHub Actions. We ingest data from 30+ distinct external sources, process over 2.5 PB of data, and deliver most data marts to business consumers with a 1-hour end-to-end latency - a standard that demands highly optimized, rock-solid transformation pipelines.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  1. DWH Platform Development

    • Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.

    • Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.

    • Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.

  2. Team contributions

    • Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.

    • Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.

    • Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.

    • Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.

    • Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.

  3. Data modeling

    • Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices.

    • Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

    • Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.

  • Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

Senior Product Manager - AI Team

About us

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the role

As the Senior Product Manager on our AI team, you'll own how AI shows up in Tebi, from an AI agent embedded in the product to the AI capabilities that run through the platform. Tebi sits on a unified foundation of sales, payments, reservations, kitchen and inventory data, which gives our AI something most restaurant software can't offer: the full picture. You'll own the vision, strategy and roadmap, and turn that data into agents and features that save merchants time, cut costs and help them make better decisions on a busy service.

What you’ll do:

  • Define and own the vision and roadmap for Tebi's AI agent and AI capabilities across the product.

  • Work with AI engineers and data teams to ship agentic features that take real actions for merchants, not just answer questions.

  • Spend time with restaurant owners, managers and staff, plus Sales and Customer Success, to find the jobs where AI genuinely removes friction in their day.

  • Define how we measure quality and trust in AI features, including evals, accuracy, adoption and merchant outcomes, and use that to iterate quickly.

  • Decide where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop moments and when the merchant makes the final call.

  • Partner with all the other product teams so AI feels native to Tebi rather than bolted on.

What you'll need:

  • 8+ years of product management experience at a fast-growing tech company, with a track record of shipping impactful launches.

  • You are highly collaborative, able to partner effectively across the organization and build trust with both technical and operational teams.

  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and a solid grasp of their strengths and limits.

  • A data-driven mindset: you combine quantitative signals and qualitative feedback, and you know how to evaluate non-deterministic products.

  • You care about the balance between craft, speed, and outcomes.

This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest on a structured environment with clear directions. We are looking for someone to set the direction and the vision for this team.

People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Generous start-up equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch provided in the office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?
Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How We Use AI at Tebi
We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability & Telemetry Data
jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer - Observability & Telemetry Data

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Observability Engineering owns the breadth and depth of observability and telemetry at Smartsheet. We build and operate the shared platform every engineering team depends on to understand how their software behaves in production (metrics, logs, distributed traces, RUM, synthetics, and AI/agentic telemetry) across a global, multi-region, commercial and government footprint. We are consolidating ownership of all of it into a single correlated platform, and treating telemetry as what it actually is: one of the largest and most valuable datasets at the company. It's a broad mandate with real scope to shape, and we hold this internal platform to the same rigor, reliability, and product standards as customer-facing software.

As a Principal Software Engineer (Observability & Telemetry Data), you will set the technical direction for how Smartsheet collects, models, stores, and derives value from telemetry data. This is an architect role: you will define the telemetry data platform and the standards that govern it, carry that architecture across engineering org boundaries, partner with our Data and AI Platform teams on Databricks and MLflow integration, and act as the company's definitive technical voice on observability. You will influence roadmaps you do not own, resolve the hard design trade-offs between fidelity and cost, and raise the technical bar for every engineer instrumenting a service.

This full-time position reports to the Team Lead, Observability Engineering and can be located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will

  • Architect the Telemetry Data Platform: Own the end-to-end design for how telemetry is landed, modeled, and queried, including open table formats, partitioning and schema evolution strategy, separation of storage and compute, tiered retention, and the query interfaces engineers actually use. Make telemetry a durable, portable, Smartsheet-owned dataset rather than a vendor-locked byproduct.
  • Own the Telemetry Data Model: Define the semantic conventions, shared business identifiers (user, org, plan, tenant), and schema standards that let any signal be correlated with any other, and drive their adoption across every service team at Smartsheet.
  • Set OpenTelemetry Direction: Lead the migration to OTel-based instrumentation, defining collector architecture, context propagation, and sampling strategy (including tail-based sampling) so that engineers can move from a log line to a trace to a metric without losing the thread.
  • Integrate AI and Agentic Telemetry with Databricks: Own the architecture connecting our observability platform to Databricks and MLflow, so that agentic and model telemetry (prompt, completion, tool and MCP calls, evaluation results) is captured un-sampled, stays useful under the input/output redaction our governance requires, and reconciles cleanly with the traces and metrics in our primary observability stack.
  • Instrument the Data Platform Itself: Bring first-class observability to our data estate, including Databricks jobs, pipelines, and warehouses, with meaningful signals for freshness, data quality, lineage, and cost, so data reliability is measured with the same discipline as service reliability.
  • Build the Analytics Layer on Telemetry: Turn telemetry into decision-grade analytics, covering reliability and incident metrics, telemetry cost and chargeback models, and adoption and coverage reporting that leadership can act on.
  • Engineer Collection and Routing at Scale: Architect the high-volume collection and routing tier (FluentBit, Kinesis, and OTel collectors) that moves telemetry from every service to its destination across US, EU, AU, and GovCloud regions, and own the migration of these pipelines as we consolidate onto a unified backend.
  • Own Telemetry Economics: Set the cost architecture for observability data, including ingest governance, cardinality control, and storage tiering, so that teams get the fidelity they need to debug without the spend pressure that causes them to under-instrument.
  • Carry Architecture Across Org Boundaries: Partner with the Data Platform, AI Platform, and infrastructure organizations to align telemetry architecture with theirs, influence roadmaps you do not own, and represent observability in company-level platform and vendor decisions.
  • Raise the Technical Bar: Lead design and code reviews, author the architecture decisions and standards others build against, and mentor senior and mid-level engineers on instrumentation, telemetry data modeling, and cost-aware design.
  • Participate in a production support and on-call rotation, taking ownership of the most complex issue resolution and driving root-cause analysis that improves system resiliency.

You Have

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, data platforms, or observability infrastructure, including time at Principal or Staff level.
  • Deep Observability Expertise: Hands-on production ownership of metrics, logs, and distributed tracing at scale, including at least one major backend (Datadog, or comparable) and a working understanding of cardinality and cost mechanics.
  • Telemetry Data Engineering: Demonstrated depth in large-scale data architecture, including open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg), Spark or comparable distributed processing, streaming ingestion, partitioning and schema evolution, and query performance and cost tuning over very large datasets.
  • Databricks Depth: Practical experience with the Databricks platform (jobs, clusters, Unity Catalog, Delta) and with MLflow for model and agent telemetry.
  • OpenTelemetry Depth: Practical experience with OTel collectors, semantic conventions, context propagation, and sampling strategy, including tail-based sampling.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Experience with high-volume log and telemetry pipelines, including FluentBit or Fluentd, streaming transport such as Kinesis or Kafka, and search backend index and mapping design.
  • Advanced AWS & Kubernetes Expertise: EKS, ECS Fargate, EC2, Lambda, and CloudWatch in production.
  • 10+ years of programming experience with modern languages such as Go, Java, Python, or Scala, and strong SQL.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, and GitOps workflows such as Flux or ArgoCD.
  • Architectural Influence at Scale: A track record of setting technical direction that multiple teams and organizations adopted, including the written artifacts (architecture decisions, standards, RFCs) that made it durable after you moved on.
  • Strong incident response instincts, with experience improving mean-time-to-resolution through better instrumentation and better data rather than more heroics.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical industry experience.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis

Nice to Have

  • Experience instrumenting LLM or agentic systems, including OTel GenAI semantic conventions and tracing agent tool-call workflows.
  • Data reliability engineering practice: freshness, quality, and lineage SLOs for production data pipelines
  • Telemetry cost engineering or FinOps at scale.
  • Experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, GovCloud) and designing telemetry that remains useful under redaction.
  • Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager.
  • Snowflake, or experience operating across more than one lakehouse or warehouse platform.
  • Service catalog or internal developer platform work (Backstage or similar).

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
jobs.description:
Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React

Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)
  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID
  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework
  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.
  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab
  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL
  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1
  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.
  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt
  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche
  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen
  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools
  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge
  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad
  • Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara
  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel
  • Teamgespräch vor Ort
  • Angebot

Über Girona

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
