Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werde Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewirb Dich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche.

Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir im Bereich IT zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Dich als (Junior) AI Application & Platform Engineer (m/w/d).

Digitalisierung, Innovation, Prozesskompetenz, Verlässlichkeit – das ist das Team der Wortmann IT. Hand in Hand arbeiten unsere Softwareentwickler, Projektmanager, Systemadministratoren, sowie Spezialisten für IT-Security, BI & Data Science daran, die Geschäftsprozesse der verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche bestmöglich durch innovative, reibungslose und stabile Prozesse zu unterstützen. Von unserem eigenentwickelten ERP-System über Standard-Anwendungen bis hin zur Serverlandschaft und unseren Rechenzentren – wir gestalten die digitale Zukunft der Wortmann Gruppe mit Leidenschaft und einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch. Unser Ziel: nachhaltige Digitalisierung, die echten Mehrwert schafft.

Als (Junior) AI Application & Platform Engineer (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Umsetzung ausgewählter KI-Vorhaben – von der Bewertung erster Prototypen bis zur Entwicklung und dem Betrieb produktionsreifer Lösungen. Du verbindest Software Engineering, KI-Integration und Plattformverständnis und stellst sicher, dass Anwendungen sicher, skalierbar, wartbar und zuverlässig betrieben werden können.

 

Was Du bei uns bewegst:

  • Du entwickelst Anwendungen, Schnittstellen und Automatisierungen, die KI sinnvoll in unsere Geschäftsprozesse integrieren – von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

  • Du erarbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Team und den Fachbereichen passende technische Lösungen und bewertest, wie sich Anforderungen praktisch umsetzen lassen.

  • Du schreibst wartbaren, modularen Code und entwickelst erste Lösungsansätze zu stabilen Anwendungen weiter.

  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für Qualität und einen zuverlässigen Betrieb: durch Tests, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation, Monitoring und automatisierte Deployments.

  • Du achtest auf einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und setzt passende Sicherheits- und Berechtigungskonzepte um.

  • Du entwickelst unsere KI-Anwendungen und Automatisierungsplattformen weiter und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um Qualität, Leistung und Wirtschaftlichkeit zu verbessern.

Was uns ausmacht:

  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur.

  • Alles, was Du zum Arbeiten benötigst: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung.

  • Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Dich gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle und der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens kannst Du Dein Berufsleben optimal an Dein Privatleben anpassen.

  • Mit uns profitierst Du von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits.

  • Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine.

  • Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Dein Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße.

  • Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de.

  • Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur.



Was Dich ausmacht:

  • Du hast Spaß daran dich mit den Möglichkeiten und Grenzen von KI auseinanderzusetzen und daraus nützliche Anwendungen zu entwickeln.

  • Du programmierst gerne, gehst technischen Fragen gerne auf den Grund und arbeitest Dich mit Neugier und Eigeninitiative in neue Themen ein.

  • Du bringst eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich IT, ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit IT-Bezug oder vergleichbare praktische Kenntnisse mit.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit Python und der Integration von KI-Modellen gesammelt.

  • Du interessierst Dich für CI/CD, Versionsverwaltung, Testing, Deployment, Monitoring und den Betrieb produktionsreifer Anwendungen – idealerweise hast Du bereits erste Erfahrung mit Docker, Kubernetes oder Cloud-Plattformen gesammelt.

  • Du arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams aus Product Ownern, Fachbereichen, Data Scientists und IT-Spezialisten zusammen.

  • Du kannst technische Gedanken verständlich erklären und kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch (mind. C1 Niveau) in Wort und Schrift.

Du bist ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzt die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

jobs.title: Content Creator Social Media (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Content Creator Social Media (m/w/d)

Wir betreuen die Social-Media-Kanäle von Kunden aus der ästhetischen Medizin und der Beauty-Branche. Gedreht wird bei uns mit dem Smartphone: schnell, nah dran und gemacht für Instagram, TikTok und Meta Ads.

Was du machst

  • 4-5 feste Halbtags-Drehs im Monat bei meinen Kunden in Hamburg und Umgebung, auf Wunsch auch mehr

  • Drehen mit dem Smartphone nach Briefing und Shotlist: Reels, kurze Interviews, Behind the Scenes, Produkt- und Behandlungsaufnahmen, Event-Content

  • Eigenständig vor Ort, denn ich bin meist nicht dabei. Am Set bist du mein Auge

  • Übergabe des Rohmaterials am selben oder am nächsten Tag, sauber benannt und sortiert. Den Schnitt übernimmt jemand anderes

  • Pflege deiner Aufgabenkarten in Notion: Status, Links, Fristen

Was du mitbringst

  • Du drehst sicher mit dem Smartphone und hast ein Gespür für Licht, Ton und Bildausschnitt

  • Du kennst Social-Media-Content und weißt, was in den ersten zwei Sekunden passieren muss

  • Ein eigenes aktuelles Smartphone mit guter Kamera. Mikrofon und Licht wird gestellt.

  • Souveränes, freundliches Auftreten. Du vertrittst mich bei Ärztinnen, Ärzten und Praxisteams

  • Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Inhalten: Bei medizinischen Kunden gelten feste Grenzen, zum Beispiel keine erkennbaren Patienten, keine Vorher-Nachher-Aufnahmen und keine Ergebnisversprechen. Ich erkläre dir das in der Einarbeitung

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Ein abgesagter Drehtag kostet einen Kundentermin

  • Von Vorteil: Führerschein, Englisch

Was ich dir biete

  • 350 € je Drehtag für 4 Stunden, jede weitere Stunde anteilig vergütet

  • Internationale Drehtag

  • Drehtage außerhalb Hamburgs

  • 4-5 feste Drehtage im Monat, planbar mit Vorlauf, optional mehr

  • Eine Einarbeitung: Ich zeige dir die Kunden, die Abläufe und die Vorlagen, bevor du allein drehst

  • Klare Briefings und Shotlists, kurze Wege, eine direkte Ansprechperson

So bewirbst du dich
Schick mir zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben, am liebsten Social-Content, den du selbst mit dem Handy gedreht hast. Dazu ein, zwei Sätze, wann du verfügbar bist. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

jobs.description:
Entrepreneur in Residence (d/f/m)

Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge

At Taxfix, we have democratized tax filing for millions of people. Now, we are building our next major growth engines.

As an Entrepreneur in Residence, you will work directly with our C-level leadership and Management Team to identify, validate, and build new business opportunities. You will take ideas from zero to one and help scale proven businesses from one to one hundred.

This role is designed for an ambitious recent graduate or early-career strategy consultant who wants to move from advising businesses to building them. You will operate with high autonomy, turn ambiguous opportunities into clear choices, and help launch ventures that can become meaningful parts of Taxfix’s future.


Your team

You will join our New Ventures function and work closely with Taxfix’s C-level leadership and Management Team.

Depending on the opportunity, you will collaborate with colleagues across Product, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Tax. You will bring the right people together, create clarity in uncertain situations, and drive initiatives from the first hypothesis through validation, launch, and scale.


Your responsibilities

  • Identify attractive customer problems and market opportunities through research, customer interviews, competitor analysis, and rapid experimentation.

  • Design and run tests to validate customer demand, willingness to pay, commercial viability, and operational feasibility.

  • Develop compelling propositions, business models, pricing strategies, unit economics, operating models, and go-to-market plans.

  • Move beyond presentations by building prototypes, coordinating pilots, acquiring initial customers, and establishing the foundations for launch.

  • Turn validated ventures into scalable businesses by developing repeatable growth engines, robust operating models, strong teams, and performance management systems.

  • Translate complex analysis into concise, decision-ready recommendations for the C-level team, Leadership Team, and Board.

  • Mobilise colleagues across Product, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Tax to move ventures forward.


Your profile

  • You have a hands-on builder mentality and do not wait for perfect resources or specialist support.

  • You use AI-native tools and vibe coding to rapidly build prototypes, automate workflows, analyse data, and turn ideas into tangible products and experiments—even if you are not a software engineer by training.

  • You are a recent graduate from a leading university or business school, such as WHU, HHL, HSG, HEC, ESADE, or a comparable institution; alternatively, you have up to two or three years of experience at a leading strategy consultancy such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, or a comparable firm.

  • You want to build companies, products, or business lines and may aspire to become a founder in the future.

  • You can break ambiguous questions down into hypotheses, analyses, experiments, and clear decisions.

  • You combine strategic depth with a strong bias for action. You are willing to speak with customers, build a model, test a landing page, or solve an operational bottleneck yourself.

  • You understand what creates customer value and can connect it to pricing, unit economics, distribution, and scalable operations.

  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing.

  • You act with pace, resilience, sound judgement, high ownership, and low ego.

  • You are fluent in German and English.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

Head of Compliance & Risikomanagement (m/w/d)

Wir entwickeln das Wertpapiergeschäft der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe weiter und schaffen ein neues digitales Neo-Brokerage-Angebot. Es richtet sich gezielt an junge, digital-affine Zielgruppen, die wir für unsere Finanzgruppe gewinnen wollen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit einem zukunftsweisenden Mobile-First-Angebot, bestehend aus einer leistungsstarken Brokerage-App, einem unverwechselbaren Marktauftritt mit erstklassigem Service und nahtlosem Zugang zu persönlicher Beratung unserer Primärbanken eine starke Antwort auf den sich wandelnden Brokerage-Markt zu geben. Dabei vereinen wir die Dynamik eines Start-ups mit der Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Bei uns hast Du die einzigartige Chance, ein innovatives Angebot von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten – von der Markenentwicklung über die User Experience bis zum Produktdesign. Flache Hierarchien und agile Arbeitsweisen erlauben dir schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Das baust du mit uns auf

Ein wirksames Compliance- und Risikomanagement schafft die Grundlage dafür, dass unser Unternehmen innerhalb klarer regulatorischer und risikobezogener Grenzen handelt. Als Head of Compliance & Risikomanagement verantwortest du beide Funktionen in der zweiten Verteidigungslinie der Bank. Du stellst sicher, dass die relevanten gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und aufsichtsrechtlichen Anforderungen eingehalten werden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Bereich identifizierst, bewertest, steuerst und überwachst du sämtliche Risiken. Dabei sicherst du die jederzeitige Risikotragfähigkeit und sorgst dafür, dass Risiken bewusst, angemessen und innerhalb der vom Management festgelegten Grenzen eingegangen werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bereichs „Compliance & Risikomanagement“ einschließlich der zugeordneten Beauftragtenfunktionen (z. B., WpHG-Compliance-, Beauftragter Regulatory Compliance, CISO, Risikocontrolling- und Auslagerungsbeauftragter)

  • Gesamtverantwortung für die Compliance-Funktion: Sicherstellung einer wirksamen Überwachung der Einhaltung wesentlicher gesetzlicher und aufsichtsrechtlicher Anforderungen

  • Etablierung bzw. Weiterentwicklung von Compliance-Standards und Richtlinien sowie Überwachung deren Einhaltung

  • Sicherstellung geeigneter Schlüsselkontrollen auf Basis risikoorientierter Überwachungspläne

  • Compliance-Risikomanagement mit Berichterstattung an das Management

  • Etablierung einer risikobewussten Unternehmenskultur („Compliance-Kultur“) mit entsprechenden Schulungen

  • Laufende Weiterentwicklung der Risikostrategie in Abstimmung mit dem Management

  • Laufendes Risikocontrolling von der Risikoinventur über die Entwicklung geeigneter Messmethoden bis zum laufenden Monitoring inkl. Stresstests

  • Überwachung der Risikotragfähigkeit

  • Regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Management

  • Verantwortung der engen Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen des GENO Broker und der DZ BANK AG, der Internen Revision, Wirtschaftsprüfern und dem Leitungsorgan

  • Etablierung und Weiterentwicklung einer angemessenen Risikokultur

  • Auslagerungs- und Drittparteien-Management (TPRM): Überwachung regulatorischer Anforderungen bei Dienstleistern und Kooperationspartnern

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die interne Meldestelle/Whistleblowing nach HinschG

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 5–7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Risikomanagement, in der Compliance-Abteilung einer Bank, in der Internen Revision oder bei einer bankennahen Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft gesammelt.

  • Du hast einen wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen, rechtswissenschaftlichen oder wirtschaftsmathematischen Studienabschluss, idealerweise nach klassischer Bankausbildung.

  • Du verfügst über Zusatzqualifikationen/Zertifikate wie Certified Compliance Officer, Abschlüsse der genossenschaftlichen Akademien (z. B. GenoAkademie oder ADG) sowie im Bereich Geldwäsche/Anti-Financial-Crime (AFC) und über nachweisbare, tiefe Kenntnisse der Bankenregulierung (insb. KWG, WpHG, GwG, EBA-Leitlinien, BaFin-Rundschreiben zu MaComp).

  • Du hast technisches Verständnis und Kenntnisse im IKT-/IT-Risikomanagement (insb. DORA-Anforderungen) sowie im Auslagerungsmanagement.

  • Du bringst neben Führungserfahrung auch Durchsetzungsstärke, Diplomatie in der Gesprächsführung (mündlich und schriftlich) sowie analytische Exzellenz mit und bist in der Lage, hochkomplexe Gesetzestexte und Zahlenwerke schnell zu durchdringen und praxisnah in Handlungsempfehlungen und Managementvorlagen zu übersetzen.

  • Du arbeitest weisungsfrei und unabhängig, ohne jegliche Form von Interessenkonflikten.

Ein sicheres Auftreten, vor allem Souveränität im Umgang mit Wirtschaftsprüfern, dem Genossenschaftsverband und Prüfern der Aufsichtsbehörden, rundet Dein Profil ab.

Benefits

Deine Vorteile

Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Frontend Engineer

About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

We're looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to help lead technically across our frontend engineering. You'll work across a group of cross-functional squads, each made up of engineers, designers, data analysts and a product manager, helping them move quickly and safely, resolving the engineering problems that span teams before they compound into systemic risk, and shaping product and business strategy with a technically-grounded, commercially-aware point of view.

We're a TypeScript-first organisation. Our frontend stack is TypeScript and React, styled with SCSS, server-side rendered with Next.js and Express, and tested with Vitest & Chromatic. As a Staff engineer you'll bring deep expertise with the latest native web technologies and modern frameworks, drive consistency across all of our web properties, and lead the migration efforts that keep our stack current, not just bumping versions, but making use of the new capabilities each release brings and helping the wider department do the same.

At Motorway, we know the importance of delivering high-quality, valuable solutions quickly, and we recognise the ability for AI tools and agents to accelerate our work. We provide our engineers with access to the latest models through Kiro. As a Staff engineer you'll define and lead our AI engineering practice on the frontend, setting standards for agent execution environments, quality harnesses, and guardrail architecture - and build a team norm where domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous feedback-loop design are treated as complementary.

What you'll be doing

  • Ship features end to end: Own meaningful pieces of product work from design handoff through to production, building accessible, performant components, wiring them into applications, and shipping them with confidence.

  • Author the contracts and the roadmap: Author and own API contracts and documentation for the department, and maintain a technical roadmap with rigorous written framing - precise intent, explicit trade-offs, and unambiguous success criteria - setting the documentation and spec-writing standard for the area.

  • Drive consistency and lead migrations: Drive consistency across all our web properties, design the standards the department builds on, and lead migration efforts - making full use of new framework features and bringing the rest of engineering along with you.

  • Own quality, security, performance and reliability standards: Set and maintain the security & web performance standards for the frontend, including client-side concerns like CSP, CWV, XSS prevention, data, governance plus reliability standards, incident review culture, and production readiness criteria.

  • Own the build and deployment story: Understand the build and deployment pipeline for our assets and services end to end, monitor and improve it, and make informed, commercially-aware decisions about hosting providers, vendors, and build-vs-buy trade-offs.

  • Develop other engineers: Develop IC3 engineers into technical leaders, raise the technical bar in hiring by defining what "good" looks like in the discipline, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high standards.

  • Lead AI-assisted engineering: Use Kiro and other AI tools to move faster, and set the standards for how the team integrates AI into its everyday workflow and its products.

What you'll have

Minimum requirements

  • At least 5+ years of experience in focused frontend practice building and operating production web applications at scale, with a track record of leading large, complex projects.

  • The ability to bridge engineering and product fluently, translating between business priorities and technical constraints in both directions, and to make and defend difficult technical decisions under uncertainty through reasoning, not authority.

  • Recognised as a technical authority in frontend engineering - engineers and product stakeholders seek you out for technical direction, and your judgement shapes decisions beyond your immediate team.

  • Deep expertise with modern CSS/SCSS, HTML, and current ECMAScript proposals, and a strong understanding of the trade-offs between different frameworks and the scenarios in which each is the right choice.

  • Comprehensive experience writing unit and E2E tests, and building the CI workflows to exercise them.

  • Deep working knowledge of TypeScript and modern React (hooks, component composition, transitions), and of frameworks like Next.js that handle SSR, routing, and data fetching.

  • Deep experience with observability, Core Web Vitals, accessibility auditing, and frontend performance tuning - and the ability to evaluate new frameworks and identify where we gain an edge in development, deployment, rendering, integration, and performance.

  • Breadth across different teams, and the judgement to make pragmatic build-vs-refactor-vs-replace calls informed by a track record of production crises and scale challenges.

  • A genuine interest in leading AI-assisted development as part of your and the team's workflow.

Additional or preferred requirements

  • Experience owning and maintaining a design system, and driving its adoption across multiple teams.

  • The ability to create sensible UI designs without a Designer for non-trivial (though not highly complex) work when the team is resource-constrained.

  • Experience evaluating vendors and third-party tools, and making build-vs-buy recommendations with clear technical and commercial criteria.

  • Experience maintaining and evolving complex legacy systems at scale.

  • Backend fluency - you don't need to be full-stack, but you're comfortable following a request deep into the API layer and shaping the contract on both sides.

Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority.

Contractors at Opencast follow the same principles as permanent consultants. The roles are varied, technical, and never confined to any one provider or solution.

Requirements

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must either currently hold active Security Check (SC) Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.

Eligibility typically requires UK citizenship and continuous residence in the UK for the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days.

As attendance at client sites is a routine part of the role’s working pattern and involves occasional travel, travel expenses are not covered.

Experience in delivering digital services for the UK government is highly valuable for many of our projects. Therefore, familiarity with the GDS toolkit will be beneficial.

Technical Skills

  • Experience in other languages such as Javascript, Typescript, Kotlin, Python or Ruby is also valuable

A contractor in software development at Opencast is responsible for:

  • Setting testing strategies to match industry standards
  • Being a technical expert in their team (or acting as the team lead)
  • Leading the technical representation in a project discovery
  • Acting as a technical lead in the team, enabling them to achieve their full potential

Salary 

£450 - £600 per day (working inside IR35)

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description:
Research Engineer

Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress
  • Real-World Evaluation & Operations
  • Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation.
  • Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates.
  • Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed.
  • Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact.

    • What skills we’d like you to have:

  • Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware.

  • Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation.

  • Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world.

  • Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity.

    • What should you expect once you apply?  

    • A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction.
    • A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews).
    • A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview.
    • Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
jobs.description:
Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. APIs, health monitoring and machine configuration management

  • Contributing to high quality code, improving robustness and maintainability of existing code


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience in Software Engineering

  • Solid Software Engineering skills

  • Programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have

jobs.title: Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)

Ben jij op zoek naar een  uitdagende baan  in de wereld van de lucht- en ruimtevaart?

En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen?  Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren.

Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden.

Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica;

  • Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring;

  • Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden;

  • De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie;

  • Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie;

  • Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten;

  • In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact;

  • Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht;

  • Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau)

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen:

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoeksprogramma’s of om te bewijzen dat we radicale en nieuwe concepten op een veilige manier effectiever en sneller kunnen certificeren. We zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor modificaties aan onze research vliegtuigen en bewijzen dat deze veilig zijn.

We zijn georganiseerd in twee marktgeoriënteerde teams, Flight Test Support en Certification Support. Veel collega’s zijn in beide teams actief en werken vaak buiten de afdeling in multi-disciplinair verband. Er worden goede mogelijkheden geboden om je eigen ontwikkeling vorm te geven.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

jobs.title: Defense Success Manager, France
jobs.description:
Defense Success Manager, France

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.


What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

Enterprise Success Manager, NL (EMEA)

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an Enterprise Success Manager at Mistral, you own what happens to our most strategic enterprise accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows, keep production ARR healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams create high-value AI use cases with our customers. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, measuring its business impact, and scaling value across the organization. You will work with customer sponsors, business teams, IT and security stakeholders, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship transformations while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the measurement that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout, a motion already credited in a major European win.

What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive

About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re currently hiring Senior Account Executives across multiple Inspira Education Group brands.

We’re looking for a driven, entrepreneurial Senior Account Executive with a strong ownership mindset. Someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and is eager to help students achieve their academic dreams. You’ll play a key role in driving revenue growth through inbound sales, while also helping to build and refine the systems and processes that will allow our sales function to scale in the future.

This is one of the most impactful roles at Inspira. As the first point of contact for parents and students exploring our programs, you’ll set the tone for their entire experience. The trust, empathy, and expertise you bring to these conversations often become the deciding factors in their choice to work with us. You’ll guide them through one of the most meaningful decisions of their lives- investing in their education and future success.

What You'll Do

  • Lead consultative intro calls (inbound) with parents and students to understand their goals, explain the admissions process, and recommend the right Inspira programs and packages based on their needs
  • Own the relationship with prospective students and families from first touch through enrollment by building trust, offering guidance, and ensuring a smooth and positive experience throughout their journey
  • Follow up strategically and consistently to stay connected with prospects, anticipate questions or concerns, and help them confidently decide to partner with Inspira
  • Experiment and innovate—test new scripts, refine messaging, and explore creative follow-up strategies to maximize conversion rates and continuously improve the enrollment experience
  • Close deals across a range of programs and services, meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly sales goals
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the marketing, counseling, and finance teams to ensure seamless handoffs, strong alignment, and an exceptional customer experience
  • Stay informed on competitor offerings and market trends; provide real-time feedback to founders and leadership to shape product, pricing, and go-to-market strategy
  • Leverage HubSpot CRM to manage the full sales cycle—tracking leads, logging communications, creating email templates, forecasting revenue, and maintaining data integrity across all stages
  • Forecast enrollments accurately by managing deal stages, values, and close dates in HubSpot
  • Support onboarding and customer success for newly enrolled students to ensure a strong start and high satisfaction

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in inbound sales within a service-oriented or consultative environment, ideally with sales cycles under 2–3 months
  • Proven success selling premium or high-value service packages (ACV $5,000+), with a track record of exceeding targets and delivering exceptional client experiences
  • Excellent communication skills. You’re confident presenting, writing, and speaking with clarity, empathy, and professionalism
  • Strong CRM proficiency, preferably in HubSpot (or similar tools), with a knack for maintaining clean data and using systems to drive performance
  • Comfort with data and reporting, including experience using Excel or Google Sheets to build and interpret dashboards
  • Nice to Have: Prior experience in education, admissions, or academic consulting sales

What We Value

As a fast-growing startup, every team member plays a pivotal role in shaping our culture and driving our success. At Inspira, we’re looking for people who embody these core values:

  • Winning Attitude: You find a way to succeed. You dig deeper to understand the “why” behind a no, and you don’t stop until you’ve found a solution
  • Curiosity: You constantly push yourself to learn, experiment, and improve. You’re open to new ideas and you see setbacks as opportunities to grow
  • Genuine Relationships: You lead with empathy and integrity. Parents and students trust us with one of the most important decisions of their lives, and you honor that by building authentic, human connections
  • Smart and Hard Work: You combine awareness and judgment with effort and discipline. You know when to think strategically and when to roll up your sleeves
  • Humility and Teamwork: You celebrate collective success over individual wins. You welcome feedback, learn from mistakes, and support those around you

Why you'll love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

Compensation

OTE: $200K+

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

Full-Time USA

jobs.title: Product & Technical Communications
jobs.description:
Product & Technical Communications

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You'll be responsible for:

  • Developing and articulating our long-term vision for the future of human-AI interaction, and what we’re building for developers and businesses.

  • Shaping the narrative around our products (in particular ElevenAgents), connecting our capabilities to emerging needs and trends in the wider world.

  • Leading storytelling and communications for top tier product launches, in partnership with product marketing, and running campaigns between launches to demonstrate the value our platform delivers.

  • Owning our security, privacy, and safety communications, including managing incident responses as part of a cross-functional team.

  • Producing superb written materials that advance our product story – including keynotes, talk tracks, social posts, and press releases – and creating scrappy product demos to show our technology in action.

  • Building the profile of our technical and product leadership, developing novel points of view, and supporting them with media, social, and event appearances.

  • Nurturing relationships with journalists, Substack writers, podcasters, technical creators, and other influencers who shape developer and enterprise buying decisions.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Run product or technical comms at a fast-paced B2B technology company, or built AI / software products.

  • A record of leading significant launches, and running effective product campaigns in between them.

  • Exceptional writing across different formats, with a talent for turning complex, technical topics into sticky narratives.

  • Experience working with security, safety, and engineering teams, and managing incidents.

  • Deep understanding of the independent media landscape and good relationships with some of the most influential commentators.

jobs.title: Email Deliverability Specialist
jobs.description:
Email Deliverability Specialist

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Caitlin, Senior Manager, Technical Support at Customer.io, and I'm looking for an Email Deliverability Specialist to join our deliverability program within Technical Support. You'll help customers reach the inbox by diagnosing sending issues, advising on best practices, and guiding senders through an email ecosystem that keeps changing.

You'll be one of several deliverability experts on a team that shares knowledge across Technical Support, so your work reaches well beyond your own queue. You'll partner with Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering: taking customer calls, equipping CSMs for customer conversations, working through complex technical cases alongside Engineering, and turning what you see in tickets into documentation, training, and better processes.

You'll thrive here if you think about the health of the whole program, enjoy improving how work gets done, and are equally comfortable digging into a detailed case and having a direct conversation with a customer about acceptable use.

What we value

Empathy and curiosity: You approach every customer with patience and a desire to dig deeper, especially when a conversation gets uncomfortable.

Clarity: You explain complex technical concepts simply and help others do the same.

Collaboration: You build strong partnerships across Support, Customer Success, and Engineering, and you treat customer outcomes as a shared goal.

Thinking at scale: You look at how we do things today and see what could work better for the whole organization, then you help make it happen.

Continuous learning: You stay ahead of evolving standards and see change as a chance to improve how we work.

What you'll do

  • Act as a trusted deliverability advisor to customers, handling complex cases through to full resolution and leading customer calls when a conversation needs it
  • Audit sender setup and monitor reputation across IPs and domains, using authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and BIMI, DNS configuration, and provider tools like Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, and Microsoft SNDS to diagnose blocklists, spam traps, and engagement drops
  • Work through highly technical issues with Engineering, taking ownership of the investigation first and sharing trends from customer cases with Product and Engineering
  • Identify acceptable use policy violations and spam complaints, hold clear and direct conversations with customers about compliance, and keep up with evolving standards (Gmail and Yahoo sender requirements, CAN-SPAM, GDPR)
  • Equip CSMs and Technical Support with the knowledge to handle deliverability conversations, through coaching, documentation, and training
  • Improve processes, tools, and one-to-many resources, such as help content, Academy course and proactive customer guidance, so deliverability support scales across the organization

What we're looking for

  • 2-4 years of experience in email deliverability at a mid-size or large ESP, B2B SaaS company, or marketing automation platform, with exposure to deliverability at scale
  • Deep understanding of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI) and infrastructure (SMTP, MTAs, DNS), with the technical comfort to work through complex issues with Engineering
  • Proficiency with provider data feeds (Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, Microsoft SNDS) and third-party deliverability monitoring tools like Everest, MXToolbox, or similar, and the analytical skill to turn bounce, engagement, and blocklist data into clear recommendations
  • Working knowledge of email compliance and acceptable use standards, and comfort having direct conversations with customers who are sending outside of them
  • Experience building or improving processes, documentation, or training that help a support or deliverability team scale
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort leading customer calls and simplifying technical concepts for any audience
  • Located in the United States or Canada
  • Bonus: participation in deliverability communities (M3AAWG, ESPC, or similar) and experience partnering with Customer Success teams

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $102,000 - $110,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager
  • 60 minute Case Study Review call with Cross-Functional Partners
  • 30 minute video call with potential Team Member
  • 30 minute final video call with Senior Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

jobs.title: Product Engineer KI-first (m/w/d) - Full Stack, 100 % remote
jobs.description:
Product Engineer KI-first (m/w/d) - Full Stack, 100 % remote

In unserem Portal bereiten mittelständische Unternehmen ihren Antrag bei der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage vor. Sie erfassen dort Projektzeiten und Kosten, laden ihre Unterlagen hoch und arbeiten mit unseren Beratern aus ihrer Entwicklungsarbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Das Portal läuft, Mandanten arbeiten damit, und es hat noch viel vor sich.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die es verantwortet. Sie haben schon einmal eine produktive Anwendung weitgehend allein getragen und wollen das wieder tun. Sie entscheiden mit, was als Nächstes entsteht, und Sie bauen es: Funktionen, Antragsprozess, Oberfläche, Server und Sicherheitsarchitektur. Dabei arbeiten Sie KI-first. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr erstes Werkzeug und nicht Ihr letztes Wort, denn Sie bauen schnell und beweisen dort, wo es zählt, dass es stimmt.

fundloop unterstützt mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung zu finanzieren. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zu den Menschen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Sie entwickeln unser Portal eigenverantwortlich weiter, von der Idee bis zum Betrieb. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Funktionen bauen, die Mandate voranbringen: Sie nehmen auf, woran Berater und Mandanten hängen bleiben, entscheiden mit uns über die Reihenfolge und liefern in kurzen Zyklen aus.

  • Den Antragsprozess weiterentwickeln: Der Weg vom Mandantengespräch bis zum fertigen Antragsentwurf ist bei uns ein geführter, KI-gestützter Ablauf mit fachlichen Prüfschritten. Sie machen ihn treffsicherer und schneller und sorgen dafür, dass er auch bei vielen parallelen Mandaten trägt. Das fachliche Urteil bleibt bei unseren Beratern.

  • Mit Sprachmodellen arbeiten, im Portal und beim Bauen: Sie gestalten Prompts, Agenten und Prüfläufe und messen, ob ein Schritt wirklich besser geworden ist.

  • Die Sicherheitsarchitektur verantworten: Mandantentrennung auf Datenbankebene, Rollen und Rechte, Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Anmeldung und Protokollierung. Unsere Mandanten vertrauen uns Personal- und Finanzdaten an. Vor jeder Auslieferung prüft deshalb ein Test die Mandantentrennung, und Sie bauen diese Beweisführung aus.

  • Server und Betrieb führen: Auslieferung, Testumgebung, Datenbankmigrationen, Backups und Überwachung. Sie halten die Umgebung schlank, nachvollziehbar und wiederherstellbar.

  • Oberfläche und Nutzerführung gestalten: Sie sorgen dafür, dass eine Geschäftsführerin oder ein Entwicklungsleiter ohne Schulung durch das Portal kommt. Ein Design-System gibt es bereits.

  • Datenschutz mitdenken: Sie setzen technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen um und entscheiden bei jedem neuen Dienst mit, ob er zu unseren Anforderungen passt.

Qualifikation

Darauf kommt es an

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen im produktiven Betrieb, in TypeScript und React, am besten mit Next.js. Eine Anwendung haben Sie schon einmal weitgehend allein getragen.

  • PostgreSQL und Zugriffskonzepte als sicheres Fundament. Row Level Security, Rollenmodelle und Migrationen sind für Sie Handwerk, und bei jeder Änderung fragen Sie, wer danach worauf zugreifen kann.

  • Sie arbeiten KI-first, beim Bauen und in der Anwendung. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr tägliches Werkzeug, Sie können ihre Ergebnisse einordnen, prüfen und verwerfen. Außerdem haben Sie schon Abläufe mit Sprachmodellen in eine Anwendung gebaut und wissen, wie man deren Qualität misst.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da Portal, Anträge und Fachgespräche auf Deutsch stattfinden. Englisch brauchen Sie für Dokumentation und Fachliteratur.

  • Betrieb in eigener Hand: Linux, Docker, Auslieferung und Backups, am besten mit einer Wiederherstellung, die Sie schon einmal wirklich geübt haben. Erfahrung mit Supabase, gern auch im Eigenbetrieb, ist ein Plus.

  • Die Anforderungen der DSGVO an Software, die personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet.

  • Gespür für Nutzerführung. Sie müssen nicht Design studiert haben, aber Sie merken, wenn ein Formular jemanden allein lässt.

  • Lust auf ein Fachthema. Das Forschungszulagengesetz müssen Sie nicht kennen. Sie sollten es aber verstehen wollen, denn die besten Funktionen entstehen dort, wo Sie den Prozess selbst durchdrungen haben.

  • Remote heißt bei uns Vertrauen. Sie setzen Ihre Prioritäten eigenständig und sagen früh, wenn etwas hakt.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Vor Ort sehen wir uns nur gelegentlich, bei uns in Düsseldorf.

  • Unbefristet, in Vollzeit oder vollzeitnaher Teilzeit, Start nach Vereinbarung.

  • Verantwortung für das Ganze. Architektur, Werkzeuge und Reihenfolge entscheiden Sie mit, statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Werkzeuge, mit denen Sie schnell sind. Aktuelle Modelle und Coding-Agenten gehören bei uns zur Grundausstattung.

  • Kurze Wege. Sie sprechen direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und mit allen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

  • Wirkung, die man sieht. Was Sie bauen, kommt kurz darauf in der Arbeit an echten Förderanträgen an.

  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind. Die Forschungszulage wächst, der Beratungsbedarf im Mittelstand wächst mit.

Wenn Sie lieber ein ganzes Portal verantworten als einen Ausschnitt davon, dann passen Sie zu uns.

So geht es weiter: Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Im ersten Gespräch lernen Sie die Geschäftsführung kennen. Im zweiten lösen Sie eine überschaubare Übungsaufgabe, die unserem Alltag nachgebaut ist, mit den Werkzeugen Ihrer Wahl, und zeigen uns Ihren Weg zum Ergebnis. Danach entscheiden wir gemeinsam und zügig.

Arbeitgeber ist die Fundloop GmbH, Fleher Str. 32, 40223 Düsseldorf.
