jobs.description:
Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) – AI-Native Development

Was wir tun

Als IoT Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 40 Kollegen*innen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden.
Aktuell sind weltweit über 500.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet.

Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten.

Unser Team

Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner etabliert.
Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen.
Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) an den Standorten GARBSEN (bei Hannover), BISSENDORF (bei Osnabrück) oder Berlin


Deine Aufgaben

Du willst nicht nur Features abarbeiten, sondern Anwendungen als Ganzes verstehen, gestalten und weiterentwickeln?

Bei der INSIDE M2M GmbH entwickelst du anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen für unsere IoT-Plattform. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt in Angular und TypeScript – und du entwickelst den Fluss durchgängig über Backend-Services mit Java und Quarkus – bis hin zu den Devices.

KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Handwerk, nicht zum Hype. Du setzt sie souverän ein, bewertest ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verantwortest Qualität, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit deines Codes.

  • Du entwickelst komplexe Angular-Anwendungen mit sauberer Komponentenarchitektur – von der Konzeption bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

  • Du arbeitest an den dazugehörigen Backend-Services in Java und Quarkus und gestaltest die Schnittstellen zwischen Frontend und Plattform mit.

  • Du integrierst KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents fest in deinen Workflow.

  • Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen, Code Reviews und die Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team, unseren Kunden und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung.

  • Ausgeprägte Praxis in Angular und TypeScript sowie gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in Java und Quarkus im Backend.

  • Vertrautheit mit REST-APIs, Datenbanken und ORM.

  • Erfahrung mit automatisierten Tests, inklusive E2E-Testing.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Coding-Workflows – z. B. mit Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du kannst erklären, welche Prompts, Setups und Guardrails bei dir funktionieren – und wo die Grenzen liegen.

  • Gutes Gespür für Softwarearchitektur, Codequalität und langfristig wartbare Lösungen.

  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift – für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kunden zwingend erforderlich.

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für technische Dokumentationen und internationale Tools.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Hintergrund in der Entwicklung oder Weiterentwicklung einer IoT-Plattform

  • Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen, Gerätedaten, Messaging oder technischen Schnittstellen

  • Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes und Cloud-native Development

  • Vertrautheit mit CI/CD, Observability oder Platform Engineering

Klingt nach dir?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Erzähl uns gerne, an welchen Softwarelösungen du bisher gearbeitet hast und wie du KI-gestützte Werkzeuge in deinem Alltag einsetzt.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung bei INSIDE M2M

Software Developer - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Software Developer - Senior Consultant

Ready to work somewhere that cares more about how you build software than how fast you can ship it?

At Opencast, we don’t measure developers by the number of tickets you complete. We care about engineering craft, clean design and thoughtful problem-solving. 
 
Opencast consultants deliver in complex environments, pairing often and working with others who take pride in doing things properly: TDD, emerging design, refactoring and leaving code better than they found it.
 
We build software we are proud of, and our clients trust us not just to code but to think, challenge and guide.
 
If you value simple and robust solutions and want a role where your judgment matters as much as your keyboard, this could be a great fit for you.

The role

Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, eXtreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation.
 
Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice.
 
Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority. 
 
The role is varied, technical, never confined to any one provider or solution and there are always opportunities for learning and development.
 

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.
 
Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 
 
SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.
 
If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.
 
We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply. 
 

Essential experience

To succeed in this role, you’ll have experience as a Senior Software Developer and be able to demonstrate, with tangible examples, that you can:
 
  • Lead the design and delivery of high-quality, user-centred services using Java or Scala.
  • Use a range of technologies, including languages such as Kotlin, Ruby or JavaScript, to solve real problems in the right way.
  • Design and build scalable, maintainable systems, considering performance, security and accessibility.
  • Build quality into your work by embedding strong testing practices throughout delivery.
  • Deliver complex digital services, supporting others to do the same.
  • Explore and adopt new technologies, helping teams learn and continuously improve.
  • Work within agile teams to deliver value early and often, adapting to changing needs.
 

Essential consulting skills

In addition to software engineering skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be an Opencast consultant. You’ll need to demonstrate how you:

 

  • Shape and guide delivery by driving clear, prioritised backlogs aligned to user and client needs.
  • Lead on technical delivery, supporting others and ensuring a high-quality approach from idea through to implementation.
  • Set and evolve testing approaches that build confidence and improve outcomes across the team.
  • Encourage collaborative ways of working, including pairing and mobbing, to share knowledge and strengthen delivery.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders, communicating openly and helping shape the right solutions.
  • Lead technical conversations in discovery and delivery, bringing clarity to complex problems.
  • Support and develop others through coaching, mentoring and sharing good practice.
  • Respond positively to change, showing resilience, adaptability and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Bring multidisciplinary teams together, aligning stakeholders and disciplines to shape solutions and deliver value for users.
 
During the interview process, we’ll ask questions to explore your experience across these areas.

 

Salary

£61,001 - £78,000 per annum.
 

What we offer


A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations.  We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.
 

Where you’ll work


This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.
 

We include you

 
We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.
 

Interview


Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.
 

Want to know more?

We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.
 
Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 
 
SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process.
 
We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.
 
If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.
 
 

We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply.

 
 

Essential experience    

You're comfortable working on complex or multiple projects. You define and deliver the work without much direction.
 
In your CV and the interview, please show how you have:
  • Distributed work and set milestones for others to achieve
  • Simplified complex problems into smaller, manageable deliverables for your team
  • Created a team charter, agreed ways of working and collaboratively iterated throughout the project
  • Organised your team and its ceremonies, encouraged team engagement and self-organisation
  • Connected team and stakeholder perspectives when making decisions
  • Influenced your team to achieve greater outcomes and remain focused on the project’s vision
  • Selected communication tools appropriate for stakeholder and team dynamics
  • Created and facilitated workshops
  • Fostered transparency and alignment through building trust
 
There are other essential skills you’ll need to be a great senior consultant. At interview, please show how you:
  • Are proactive, and can work autonomously
  • Challenge appropriately and resolve conflict
  • Help others to successfully work through challenges
  • Support and develop teams, and build impactful relationships
  • Contribute to communities and client teams beyond project work
 

With a significant proportion of our client base in the public sector, we are particularly interested in candidates with experience working in central or local government and/or the NHS.

 

Experience working to the GOV.UK Service Standards, including passing service standard assessments at different stages, is a desirable skill. If you have this experience, please demonstrate this on your CV to discuss at interview. 

 

Essential consulting skills

In addition to business analysis skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be an Opencast consultant. You’ll need to demonstrate how you:
  • Contribute to improving ways of working and driving continuous improvements within your teams.
  • Share knowledge and best practice with fellow delivery managers and other disciplines, including proactively engaging in client and Opencast communities of practice.
  • Positively challenge decisions or solutions you don’t agree with, striving for the best client outcomes.
  • Create lasting value in the projects you work on, ensuring a user-centric, sustainable approach.
  • Engage with Opencast in a meaningful way, supporting the growth of your practice and wider capability.
  • Support Opencast's growth plans, by providing case studies and updates into the relevant forums of your project work.
 

Salary 

£60,000 - £70,000 per annum.
 
 

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations.  We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.
 
 

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.
 
 

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   
 
 

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.  
 
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Pourquoi recrutons-nous ?

Notre positionnement unique sur le marché vous permettra d’allier des compétences techniques telles que l’économétrie, l’économie, les statistiques et les mathématiques appliquées avec de la programmation. Il vous permettra également de développer des compétences en stratégie, conseil et marketing afin de répondre au mieux aux problématiques business de nos clients.

Votre rôle dans l’équipe :

• Vous savez analyser des données et les transformer en recommandations stratégiques pour répondre aux enjeux business.

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Vous souhaitez découvrir concrètement comment se développent les projets de stockage par batteries et contribuer à la transition énergétique ? Vous participerez, à votre niveau, à l’identification de sites et à la préparation des premières analyses et démarches d’autorisation pour des projets de stockage. Vous accompagnerez également dans leurs missions de développement de projets solaires les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets et les Chef.fe.s de projets.


Vos missions

·         Identification de sites pour des projets de stockage par batteries. Pour cela, un travail d’analyse et de suivi des évolutions techniques et réglementaires devra être réalisé.

·         Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux).

·         Accompagner les Chef.fe.s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions.

·         Bac +5 type Master ou Ingénieur généraliste ou énergie .

·         Un intérêt marqué pour les énergies renouvelables, les systèmes électriques et la transition énergétique.

·         À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs.

·         Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe.

·         Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques ; la connaissance des outils SIG ou de la réglementation en urbanisme et en environnement constitue un plus.

·         Bon niveau de français ; la connaissance de l’anglais est appréciée dans notre environnement international.

 

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables.

 

Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte?

💰 Une gratification de stage de 900 € par mois, dans le respect de la réglementation en vigueur.

🚆 Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport en commun.
📚 Des opportunités de développement et de croissance au sein de notre scale-up international.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. 

 

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. 

 

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role:

As our first dedicated pre-sales hire, you'll own the technical side of the sales process end to end. Today this work is spread across our CTO, and Solutions Architects team. You'll take it over and shape it into something scalable. You'll partner with prospects during their most important technical conversations, helping them understand how DeepJudge fits into their firm. These are technically demanding deals: top law firms and corporate legal teams apply serious security scrutiny, run complex enterprise environments spanning document management systems and identity providers, and weigh on-prem against cloud deployment, all against datasets that can run to hundreds of millions of documents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Can understand a complex product deeply and explain it clearly and persuasively to any audience, from law firm partners and C-level executives to IT leaders and engineers

  • Are genuinely excited about technology, software, and AI, and curious about the legal space. You're comfortable getting into infrastructure details, integration details, and security, and you have a clear track record of ramping fast on technical topics

  • Are energized by a fast-moving startup environment rather than a highly structured one

  • Exposure to the highest-tier law firms and legal teams in the industry

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het standaardiseren van een controle, technische overdracht of SAP-werkwijze. Je test jouw oplossing samen met de betrokken collega's, zodat je aan het einde van je stage een verbetering oplevert die daadwerkelijk binnen Werkvoorbereiding kan worden gebruikt.


Wij vragen

Wij bieden

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

jobs.description:
Founding Recruiter

About Ataraxis AI

Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients.

Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research.

Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide.

At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine.

Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity).

We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting from sourcing through close

  • Source creatively: competitor mapping, adjacent industries, referrals, and AI-powered tools

  • Build the hiring engine, including interview processes, scorecards, candidate experience, and funnel and time-to-fill reporting

ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role where you’ll operate at both strategic and tactical levels: guiding the roadmap, developing new business models, diving into the details of experiments, and scaling what works. You’ll partner closely with co-founders, executives, and cross-functional leaders across engineering, design, data, and marketing to align on bold goals and deliver fast. Above all, you’ll bring a founder’s mindset to growing one of the most loved consumer education products in the world.

Manager, Technical Accounting

Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll operate as Liftoff’s technical accounting expert—drafting and reviewing technical memos, guiding policy, and ensuring that our financial statements appropriately reflect accounting for complex transactions. At Liftoff, our industry as well as our company’s growth present unique challenges for the accounting team. You’ll be tackling some of the most complex and innovative transactions in the industry, often operating at the frontier of accounting standards where clear precedent doesn’t yet exist. If you thrive on solving problems that even Big 4 National Offices debate, and enjoy turning ambiguity into well-reasoned, defensible positions, this role will keep you constantly challenged and engaged.

Responsibilities

  • Research and document technical accounting positions (revenue, stock based compensation (SBC), leases, debt, capitalized software (CapSW)).
  • Prepare journal entry support for complex accounting areas (SBC, CapSW, Debt, significant non-recurring transactions, etc).
  • Own accounting policies
  • Drive implementation of new accounting standards from initial research to operationalization and disclosure impact.
  • Own equity-related technical accounting from review of grant setup in Equity Edge Online (EEO) to disclosures.
  • Prepare statement of equity and statement of cash flows, as well as financial statement footnotes for complex areas, including earnings per share and stock-based compensation, and stockholders’ equity.
  • Prepare SBC expense support for quarterly journal entries
  • Assist in preparation and tie out of Proxy disclosures
  • Collaborate with Legal, FP&A, and business teams on new contracts and billing structures.
  • Support audits with technical documentation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance, and 6 years of experience
  • CPA required
  • Public accounting experience, ideally Big 4 experience
  • Expertise in US GAAP
  • Ownership and accountability: Take ownership of deliverables, deadlines, risks, and outcomes while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and quality.
  • Prioritization and execution: Manage competing priorities and tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to accurately interpret data.
  • Strong communication skills: clearly communicate complex technical accounting matters to cross-functional stakeholders and auditors.
  • Adaptability: remain calm and effective in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and adapt to evolving business, accounting and reporting requirements.

Location:

Liftoff follows a philosophy of "remote first, come together meaningfully" and allows employees to be based from a number of different states where we have entities. We require that this role work during Pacific time zone; working from the San Francisco Bay Area is highly preferred.

Travel Expectations:

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:

Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. This role includes On Target Earnings (OTE) including a 10% bonus.

The following are our OTE (base + bonus) ranges for this role:

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung. Du führst das bestehende Team und baust Prozesse, Standards und SOPs auf. Für unsere Key-Hires in Sales und Account Management trägst du die volle Verantwortung, vom Erstkontakt bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Die besten Kandidaten suchen meist gar nicht, deshalb gehst du über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache selbst auf sie zu.

Du steuerst den gesamten Funnel: Kennenlerngespräch, Bewerbungsgespräch, Probetag, Referenzcheck und Angebot. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur, also Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs, Landingpages und Recruiting-Ads. Du legst fest, was im Recruiting gemessen wird, und setzt das Dashboard in Close und Recruitee so auf, dass es echte Entscheidungen ermöglicht. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst wertest du die Zahlen aus, erkennst Engpässe und passt Prozesse an.

Deine Recruiter führst und coachst du, und mit Call-Reviews sicherst du die Qualität ihrer Arbeit. Neue Hires übergibst du sauber an die Teamleads und ins Onboarding. Was die Probezeit zeigt, fließt bei dir zurück in den Auswahlprozess. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht an Aktivität, sondern an Ergebnissen:

  • Time-to-Hire pro Rolle
  • Conversion zwischen den Funnel-Stufen
  • Anzahl qualifizierter Kandidaten bis zur Besetzung
  • Offer-Acceptance-Rate
  • Pipeline-Abdeckung für unsere Key-Rollen
  • Wer von deinen Hires die Probezeit besteht und nach 90 Tagen performt
  • Performance deines Teams

Nach 90 Tagen erwarten wir ein Recruiting-Dashboard, dem die Geschäftsführung vertraut, einen dokumentierten Funnel mit SOPs und die ersten Key-Hires in Sales oder Account Management.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Recruiting oder Talent Acquisition, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer führenden Rolle, etwa als Teamlead, Head of oder Recruiting Lead
  • Eigener Sales-Background: Du warst selbst im Closing, im Setting oder als Sales Lead aktiv. Du weißt, wie Vertriebler ticken, weil du einer bist
  • Nachweislich besetzte Sales- und Account-Management-Rollen im B2B-High-Ticket-Umfeld, etwa in Agentur, Beratung, Coaching oder Online-Business
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-System mit Funnel, Prozessen, Scorecards und Tracking aufgebaut und nicht nur darin gearbeitet
  • Echte KPI-Verantwortung: Du kennst deine Zahlen zu Time-to-Hire, Funnel-Conversion, Kandidaten pro Besetzung und Probezeit-Erfolg
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-Team aufgebaut, geführt und auf Performance gebracht, auch wenn es ein kleines war
  • Hunter-Gen: Du findest die besten Kandidaten über Active Sourcing, Direktansprache und Netzwerke, auch wenn sie gar nicht suchen
  • Treffsicheres Profiling: Du erkennst früh, ob jemand im High-Ticket-Sales liefern wird, und lässt dich von guter Selbstdarstellung nicht blenden
  • Ownership: Wenn zwei Wochen lang kein Bewerbungsgespräch zustande kommt, merkst du es selbst, findest die Ursache und handelst, bevor jemand fragt
  • Sehr starke Kommunikation: Du verkaufst unsere Vision ehrlich, selektiv und auf Augenhöhe mit A-Playern
  • Pluspunkte:
    • Du warst selbst Head of Sales, Sales Lead oder selbstständig im Vertrieb bzw. im Headhunting
    • Du hast ein Netzwerk in der Closer- und Agentur-Szene im DACH-Raum
    • Du hast hohes Hiring-Volumen mit mehreren parallel offenen Rollen gestemmt
    • Du hast Erfahrung mit Scorecards, Probetagen, Case Studies und Referenzchecks
    • Du kennst Close, Recruitee oder vergleichbare CRM- und ATS-Systeme samt Recruiting-Dashboards

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du HR-Generalist bist und vor allem Personalverwaltung, Verträge, Payroll und Feel-Good machst. Das ist eine Recruiting-Rolle, keine HR-Rolle
  • du bisher nur Stellen gepostet und Kennenlerngespräche geführt hast, ohne je ein System, ein Team oder Zahlen zu verantworten
  • du nie selbst verkauft hast und Vertriebler nur von außen kennst
  • du ein fertiges Setup, große Budgets und lange Freigabeschleifen brauchst, um zu liefern
  • du dich hervorragend präsentieren, aber nicht mit konkreten Zahlen belegen kannst, was du tatsächlich besetzt hast
  • Remote für dich Freiheit von Verbindlichkeit bedeutet
  • du lieber als externer Freelancer auf Projektbasis arbeitest, statt Teil des Teams zu sein
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht wachsen willst

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich bei uns und werde Teil unseres Teams.

Quality Assurance - Senior Consultant

Ready to keep quality at the heart of projects with impact?

Do you want to make a real impact by ensuring quality in services? Are you ready to grow your skills in a supportive, knowledge-sharing community where you can achieve your potential?

We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. As a Quality Assurance consultant, you’ll ensure that quality assurance is considered from the start through testing, questioning and improving. You’ll apply your adaptability and communication skills across a variety of projects, working with a vibrant QA community that champions learning and knowledge sharing.

The Role 

You'll work on public and private sector projects. You’ll likely be working as a lead software quality engineer on internal and client-facing projects, contributing to the leadership of teams. 

Leading by example and promoting the Opencast approach, you’ll support colleagues to develop knowledge and work through challenges in all testing types. You’ll decide the best thing for your team to be working on. You'll collaborate with team members, clients and users to ensure that high quality is maintained and best practices are followed throughout the project. You'll adapt to different tools and technologies, advising on the best ones to use. 

You'll ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client. 

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients. 

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements. 

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying. 
 
We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply. 

Technical Skills 

To succeed in this role, you must have experience working as a lead software tester on multiple complex projects and have a good understanding of what it means to be a senior consultant. 

In your CV and at interview, you’ll need to show experience of: 

  • Your working area and how you apply this to your role

  • Functional and non-functional automation testing using tools like Playwright

  • Mentoring and Coaching team members, supporting their development and progression within QA

  • Creating test documentation

  • Resolving complex issues and presenting findings to stakeholders

  • Creating tasks from high-level requirements

  • Leading and facilitating meetings, including test planning, defect triage, stand-ups and retrospectives

  • Acting as a senior point of contact for stakeholders, demonstrating leadership in both delivery and communication

 

You’ll need a good understanding of: 

  • Basic principles of programming paradigms, such as object-orientated programming and procedural programming 

  • The concepts and benefits of OAT testing. 

 

As well as QA skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be a great consultant.  

In the interview, we will assess how you have: 

  • Demonstrated strong attention to detail and focus on high-quality outcomes

  • Took a methodical approach to resolving complex problems

  • Respectfully challenged decisions or solutions when necessary

  • Communicated effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Proactively sought solutions to mitigate risk

  • Raised risks and issues using the appropriate tools and processes

  • Built strong working relationships and successfully resolved conflicts

  • Led project meetings and actively contributed to workshops and events

Other experience 

Some areas of experience are not essential but relevant to the role: 

  • UK government service standards
  • Agile methodology

Salary

£56,001-£60,000

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from flexible working hours (aligned to client commitments), 25 days’ holiday, and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We also offer wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team. 

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

Member of Product Staff, Product Designer

Coding was first. Recruiting is next. We are building it.

Metaview is an applied AI lab building AI coworkers for some of the world's most ambitious recruiting teams. Hear directly from our customers. The challenge is not another chatbot. It is software that can pursue a hiring objective, operate within real workflows, seek judgment at the right moment, and earn a customer's trust.

We have one value: velocity.

Not motion for its own sake, but real progress. We ship every day, ship on Fridays, and skip the tickets, roadmaps, and design-doc theater. Every builder on the team orchestrates a stack of agents, and we ship 8x what we did a year ago with the same small team. That pace needs a designer whose thinking keeps up: someone who can go from a vague problem to a clear, high-fidelity answer in hours, not sprints, and put it in front of engineers and customers while the idea is still hot. Process stays light, standards stay high, and feedback loops stay short.

What you'll design

Day to day, you'll own:

  • the look and feel of new product experiences across the hiring workflow, from first sketch to final pixels

  • interfaces that make AI agents feel transparent, trustworthy, and like a real coworker

  • the moments where conversational signal becomes something a user can see, trust, and act on

  • fast, high-fidelity prototypes that prove or kill an idea before anyone commits to building it

  • the craft bar for the whole product: motion, density, hierarchy, and the details that make it feel inevitable

What you'll own

In your first 3–6 months, you should:

  • own meaningful product areas end-to-end, from problem definition through rollout, in close partnership with engineering

  • set how Metaview's AI products look, feel, and behave in real customer workflows

  • turn messy, ambiguous problems into interfaces that feel obvious in hindsight

  • raise the bar across craft, execution, and product judgment

What we're after

We're likely to be excited by people who:

  • have designed and shipped beautiful, complex products in fast-moving software environments

  • are deep specialists in product design: interaction, visual craft, and systems thinking at the highest level

  • have a real point of view on products: what's great, what's broken, and what they'd change

  • care about the pixels, the motion, and the details most people never notice

  • like ownership, ambiguity, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, product, and customers

  • want to help define what AI-native software feels like while the shape of the company is still being formed

What you bring

Helpful signals include experience with:

  • designing products where the pixels matter: rich, interactive, information-dense interfaces

  • design systems, real-time collaboration, or other hard interaction problems

  • AI-native interfaces: agent interactions, streaming and loading states, the in-between moments of a conversation

  • a portfolio that shows real obsession with craft, and the reasoning behind the decisions

  • startup or scale-up environments where iteration speed and ownership are both high

What you want to know — San Francisco

  • A small, sharp, in-person team in San Francisco. Best ideas win on merit, not ceremony. Want to know what it's actually like? Read our unfiltered Slack at metaview.ai/careers#slackbook.

  • We pay in the top 10% of the SF market: salary plus meaningful equity. Our process is fast and direct, and it's not unusual to hear back the same day.

  • Simplified leveling: early-career, mid-career, and staff and above. Your level sets your comp. No back-and-forth, no games.

  • Market refreshers, twice a year. We re-benchmark against the market twice a year and move comp up when it drifts, so "top 10%" stays true after your start date too.

  • Promotions and raises on a real cycle. We review level and scope roughly every six months. When your responsibilities grow, your comp follows. Raises are tied to a real change in the work, not an automatic bump.

  • Equity that's truly competitive. World-class option grants so we're all owners. The structure stays simple: cash and equity.

  • Visa sponsorship and immigration support. We sponsor work visas and handle the process with you, start to finish.

  • Health, fully covered. 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums, for you and your dependents.

  • Unlimited time off. You should feel empowered to take as much time off as you need.

Senior AI Engineer

Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

  • Compensatory time off (RTT)

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile)

jobs.title: Mid Market Account Executive - English Speaking
jobs.description:
Mid Market Account Executive - English Speaking

About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the Role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving growth across one of Prelude’s most strategic segments: mid-sized businesses with high-scale authentication needs. You’ll own the full sales cycle, manage complex evaluations with multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with our technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

You’ll help shape our mid-market motion, refine our GTM strategy, and play a meaningful role in expanding Prelude’s footprint across Europe and beyond. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has experience closing mid-market deals and wants to join a fast-growing startup where their impact is immediate and visible.

What will you be doing?

• Owning and managing the sales cycle for mid-market accounts, from outbound prospecting to contract execution.

• Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of high-value prospects across key verticals.

• Leading consultative discovery processes to understand customer needs, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

• Delivering high-quality demos and value-driven pitches tailored to mid-market use cases.

• Navigating multiple stakeholders — from product and engineering to procurement and legal.

• Consistently exceeding quota while maintaining healthy win rates and sales velocity.

• Delivering on cross-sell, up-sell and renewal opportunities

• Sharing insights from customer interactions to help refine product strategy, messaging, and positioning.

• Representing Prelude at industry events, conferences, and on-site customer meetings.

What are we looking for?

• Experience in B2B SaaS sales, including experience closing mid-market deals.

• A strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota.

• Confidence managing multi-stakeholder, multi-step sales processes

• Curiosity - you'll enjoy unpacking how products work under the hood.

• The ability to think strategically about accounts, to identify and engage economic buyers.

• Someone who will thrive in a fast-paced environment, who enjoys taking initiative.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

• Fluency in English

• Enthusiasm for our product and potential

What we offer:

• Competitive salary with uncapped commission and generous BSPCEs.

• Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office, 1 day remote

• High-quality equipment and ergonomic setup.

• Annual company offsite (most recent was in the South of France).

• A close-knit, high-caliber team that prioritizes product excellence and customer success.

• Private healthcare.

• Pension scheme.

• Swile meal vouchers.

Interview Process

• A 30-minute call with our talent team to get to know each other.

• A 30-minute session with someone in the sales team to go deeper into the role.

• On-site interview at our Paris office, including a sales presentation and team meet-and-greet.

• A 1-hour meeting with our CEO to explore our strategy and long-term vision.

Compensation: €150K • Offers Equity

AI brings huge potential, but many companies are still struggling to release the desired impact. We are a pragmatic and dynamic team to help “empower our business clients with AI”. You, as a talent, are needed to grow our business which started up from three founders with proven track-records in AI consulting and scaled AI implementations. 

 

For our powerful team, we are looking for a Swiss based Senior AI Engineer / Consultant to develop and deliver innovative AI solutions for our customers in the German- and French-speaking regions of Switzerland.

Your mission

  • Design, implement, and deploy pragmatic AI solutions using state-of-the-art technologies, tailored to client needs and habits, to solve pressing business problems

  • Leverage AI solutions and client data to drive real-world impact and address critical business challenges

  • Work in high-performing, agile teams and play an active role throughout the project life cycle - from contributing to project proposals to designing and deploying solutions, as well as supporting business development activities

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across clients, partners and internal teams

  • Contribute to Artifact’s growth by developing assets and driving initiatives that support the company’s success

  • Work on real-world projects with Swiss clients, using the latest AI technologies and software

  • Get started right away by working on client projects starting your first months at Artifact

  • As a Senior AI Engineer / Consultant, you will take a leadership role in both internal and external projects while actively building strong relationships with clients to expand into additional engagements

  • Be involved in shaping our internal asset and strategy - your ideas and technical skills will help move Artifact forward

  • Enjoy a flexible work environment where you can grow, learn, and be part of a team that is passionate about AI

About Artifact

Artifact is dedicated to empowering people with AI for the better. As a professional service provider, we do AI and Data Science. Together, we are leveraging the best ideas to find pragmatic and sophisticated solutions with the best suited technology. We help our business clients from any sectors and any size, to accelerate their journey with AI and deliver real impact. 


Your profile

  • Fluency in Python, along with experience in Git, SQL, DevOps and MLOps

  • Familiarity with analytics libraries, visualization tools and Big Data frameworks, e.g. NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark

  • Enjoying communication and building relationships with clients and teams is a plus

  • Willingness to travel in Switzerland and available work permit in Switzerland

  • You intend to start your new job  at Artifact within the next 3 months from your point of application

Additional preferred qualification:

  • Experience in consulting

  • Experience in frontend engineering e.g. React

  • Experience as a full stack engineer is a plus

You’re the ideal candidate if you’re:

  • Ready to move out of your comfort zone

Senior Client Partner – Steuerlösungen Public Sector (w/m/d), 80–100 %

Information Factory steht für Management Consulting, Technologie und datenbasierte Lösungen. Für die Betreuung führender kantonaler Steuerverwaltungen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer etablierten Steuerlösungen suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Kundenbeziehungen, Fachprozesse und Technologie miteinander verbindet.

Deine Mission

Du gestaltest langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden fachlich-technische Roadmaps und sorgst dafür, dass unsere geschäftskritischen Lösungen nachhaltigen Nutzen schaffen. Dabei verbindest du Lösungsdesign, Betrieb, Sicherheit, Organisation und die Perspektive der Fachbereiche.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Wichtige Kundenbeziehungen im kantonalen Steuerumfeld betreuen und weiterentwickeln

  • Client-Success-Pläne mit messbaren Ergebnissen und klaren Review-Punkten entwickeln

  • Kundennutzen, Adoption und Beziehungsqualität steuern und Risiken früh erkennen

  • Fachlich-technische Mehrjahres-Roadmaps mit Fachbereich, IT, Betrieb und Management erarbeiten

  • Bestehende Steuerlösungen und das Lösungsportfolio im Public Sector weiterentwickeln

  • Informationssicherheit, Auditierbarkeit, Business Continuity und hohe Verfügbarkeit einbeziehen

  • Neue Vorhaben identifizieren und Angebote gemeinsam mit dem Account Management entwickeln

Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Delivery

Du verantwortest Kundenbeziehung, Kundenergebnisse, Adoption, gemeinsame Roadmap und Account-Entwicklung. Der Solution Delivery Manager verantwortet Umsetzung, Umfang, Termine, Budget, Qualität, Releases und Betriebsbereitschaft. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für realistische Zusagen und klare Erwartungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Erfahrung oder einen gleichwertigen Leistungsausweis mit komplexen strategischen Kunden

  • Nachweisbare End-to-End-Verantwortung für ein geschäftskritisches System oder eine vergleichbare Lösungslandschaft im Betrieb

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmaps, Zielbildern oder Transformationsvorhaben

  • Praxis in einem regulierten, auditpflichtigen oder hochverfügbaren Umfeld

  • Ausgeprägte Beratungs-, Kommunikations-, Stakeholder- und Moderationsfähigkeiten

  • Unternehmerisches Urteilsvermögen mit Fokus auf langfristigen Kundennutzen

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, mindestens C1, und Englisch mindestens B2

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmässigen Kundenterminen in der Schweiz

Besonders wertvoll

Erfahrung im Schweizer Steuerwesen, in einer kantonalen Verwaltung oder im weiteren Public Sector ist ein starker Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Die Steuerdomäne kann aufgebaut werden. Ebenfalls wertvoll sind Kenntnisse von eGovernment, eCH-Standards, Informationssicherheit, öffentlicher Beschaffung, HERMES oder regulierten Hochverfügbarkeitsumgebungen.

Was dich erwartet

Sinnstiftende Arbeit an langfristigen Lösungen für Bürgerinnen, Bürger und Behörden, direkter Austausch mit Entscheidungsträgern und Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Consulting, Engineering, Delivery und Betrieb. About the role

We are looking for a Senior .NET Backend Developer who combines strong system design skills with a passion for engineering excellence. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of core backend services - driving solutions from initial architecture through deployment and production across our cloud platforms. 

Beyond shipping high-quality code, you will play a key role in raising the engineering bar across the team. You’ll mentor mid-level and junior developers, establish best practices around testability and clean architecture, and foster a collaborative environment. We also encourage our engineers to utilize modern AI developer tools (like Cursor, Claude code) to accelerate daily workflows and problem-solving.

Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

  • Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

  • Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

  • Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

  • Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

  • Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

  • Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

  • Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

  • Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

  • Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid.

✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs).

✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment).

✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure.

✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack.

1st class Polarsteps extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

jobs.description:
Principal Security Engineer (Remote Eligible)

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

AI is reshaping what product security can accomplish, both as a target and as a tool. We're looking for a Principal Security Engineer to own the highest-leverage application security work at Smartsheet: leading threat modeling and product security reviews across a modern SaaS platform used by millions of customers, serving as the team's technical authority on AI security risk, and setting the technical standard for application security practice across the engineering organization.

This is the most senior individual contributor role on the Application Security team. The expectation is not just depth: it is reach. You will engage product and engineering leadership directly, drive security requirements rather than advisory recommendations, and build team capability over time. If you are a security engineer who thinks upstream, builds threat models that generate concrete test scenarios and can translate technical findings into architecture decisions and business outcomes, this role is built for you.

This role reports to the Manager, Application Security and can be based in our Bellevue, WA office or remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

  • Lead Threat Modeling and Product Security Reviews: Own threat modeling and product security review as the team's primary upstream capability: build models from architecture and data-flow artifacts, derive concrete abuse cases and test scenarios, and drive security requirements into designs before they ship. Define and lead the product security review service (set the service model, triage criteria, and enforcement posture) and personally execute reviews for high-risk features with documented findings and remediation timelines. Engage product and engineering directly to establish security requirements at the design phase, with the technical credibility to influence architecture decisions.
  • Define AI Security Methodology and Drive It Across the Practice: Define how AI security risk is assessed, monitored, and mitigated across product, engineering, and third-party AI integrations, with recognized depth on the current threat landscape: LLM workflows, agentic pipelines, MCP-based integrations, and attack classes including prompt injection, indirect injection, and tool-calling authorization gaps. Own and evolve the AI-assisted security review capability: evaluate detection value, assess build-vs-buy tradeoffs, and shape toolchain coverage as Smartsheet's AI-integrated product surface scales.
  • Shape AppSec Technical Direction and SDLC Controls: Serve as the technical authority for the AppSec program's SDLC control surface (secure coding guidelines, CI/CD pipeline security strategy, and toolchain direction across SAST, SCA, secrets, and IaC scanning) with the depth to influence tool decisions and resolve standards decisions that span teams without primary operational ownership. Build runbooks, standards, and documentation that create consistency and reduce single-point-of-failure risk as the team scales.
  • Elevate Team Capability and Engineering Organization Influence: Mentor AppSec team members on threat modeling tradecraft and security review design, and serve as the trusted technical voice with product and engineering leadership, framing risk in terms that move architecture decisions. Your judgment shapes how the team prioritizes and how the broader organization understands and invests in application security.

You Have:

  • 10+ years in application security with a track record of sustained technical leadership in product security or AppSec engineering, including direct ownership of threat modeling programs and security review services at scale.
  • Ability to own threat modeling as a systematic practice (STRIDE, data-flow and architecture diagram driven), producing concrete, actionable test scenarios and abuse cases, embedded into agile design cycles as a repeatable, lightweight practice.
  • Hands-on experience securing AI-integrated applications (LLM workflows, agentic systems, model APIs, MCP-based integrations) with fluency in the OWASP LLM Top 10 and current AI attack classes, plus experience using AI tooling to scale security review coverage.
  • Experience doing architecture review and targeted manual code review for complex SaaS features, with a track record of driving remediation requirements through to implementation with enough technical credibility to influence design decisions at the engineering leadership level.
  • Experience mentoring engineers into threat modeling ownership and attacker-mindset review design; demonstrated track record of establishing security requirements as design-phase gates and sustaining engagement with engineering teams to drive implementation.
  • Sufficient depth in SAST, SCA, secrets, and IaC scanning in modern CI/CD pipelines to credibly influence toolchain direction, resolve standards decisions that span teams, and shape secure coding standards without primary operational ownership; cloud security fundamentals sufficient to tie application controls to the infrastructure they run on.
  • Fluent in one or more modern languages (Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or equivalent); comfortable reading production codebases to surface issues tooling misses and writing or extending automation others can maintain.
  • Expertise communicating risk and security requirements (written and verbal) clearly across audiences from engineering ICs through executive leadership; recognized as a trusted technical voice by partner teams.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships across engineering, product, and security organizations; earns influence through technical credibility and sustained engagement.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

Nice to Have:

  • GitLab CI/CD experience, including security policy pipeline configuration and scanning job integration.
  • Experience building AI-assisted security tooling or LLM-integrated review workflows that scale security review coverage.
  • Penetration testing depth including exploit writing or vulnerability chaining to validate exploitability and prove real-world impact.
  • Public-facing security contributions: conference speaking, CVE credits, published research, or industry community recognition that reflects the technical authority expected at principal level.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$205,000—$257,500 USD

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
